journeys.journey: J1: "I want to share this project with my friend." A first-time phone user (fresh install, 390x844, iPhone notch emulated, touch phone) goes from opening the app to holding something they can send (link, short code, QR, long code). Environment note: on localhost the app refuses the public relays, so every share panel here shows the red "Couldn't reach the free connection service" line. On his phone it should read "Waiting for people · the link and the code are live". Because of that, the link and short-code routes were judged from the screens and the code. The long connection-code route was proven end to end between two separate Chromes.
journeys.walked:
All screenshots are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ezrasmith-Claude-FreeMotion/fde0eeaf-7d73-45b8-9f83-7761553e344d/scratchpad/a967/j1/ (called J1/ below). I drove the app with real touch taps through my own CDP driver (../drv.py). Each tap checked elementFromPoint first, and none of the taps landed on something covering the target.
1. Fresh install: Home is empty, no projects (J1/01-home-fresh.png). Tapped the + (#hm-new), the New project sheet opened (J1/02-after-plus.png), tapped Create and landed in the editor (J1/03-editor-new-project.png). The top bar has back, name, version, ?, notes, cog (aria "Canvas settings") and ↑ (Export). Labs is off: no #btn-share, no #hm-join-btn, no #collab-people.
2. Tapped ↑, the button that looks like the iPhone Share icon. It opens the Export dialog only, with nothing about live sharing (J1/05-export-tapped.png).
3. Tapped the cog. Canvas settings opens with a "Friends · Share it live with friends" bar above the canvas card (J1/04-canvas-settings.png).
4. Tapped the Friends bar. It opened "Work on this with friends · Live sharing is still being tested", an explanation, a Live collaboration switch and a 7-line privacy paragraph (J1/06-friends-labs-off.png).
5. Flipped the switch. The block became "Share "Project 1" · Not shared yet": a You row with Set up…, Start sharing, "Opening this never shares anything by itself.", "New people join as Editor ▾" and Done. The switch is gone. A 28px person+ appeared at the stage's top-left (J1/07-friends-labs-on-idle.png).
6. Tapped Start sharing. The "What should others see?" sheet opened with the name field focused (J1/08-profile-prompt.png). Continue with an empty name shows "Type a name so people know who you are." Typed "Mia" and pressed Return: nothing happened (card still up, profile still null; J1/10-profile-typed-return.png). Cancel went back to the idle block with no message (J1/09-after-profile-cancel.png).
7. Continue with a name: "Live · waiting for someone", the Comments row, then "Invite with a link or a code": Copy link, Share…, QR, the short code with Copy, and Reset link and code. A "Keep FreeMotion open — the session pauses when your screen locks" toast lay on top of the short code for 3.6 s (J1/11-share-panel-top.png, J1/12-share-panel-after-toast.png).
8. Copy link showed the toast "Link copied", and the clipboard held https://builderezra.github.io/FreeMotion/#j=… (J1/13-after-copy-link.png). QR drew a 196px code with "Point the other phone's camera at this." (J1/14-qr-shown.png). Scrolling down: Ask me first / Let them in, New people join as, Connect with a code instead, and the privacy paragraph again (J1/15-share-panel-bottom.png).
9. Tapped Connect with a code instead: "Step 1 · send them this code" (a 233-character FM1 code) with Copy code, then "Step 2 · paste the code they send back" and Connect (J1/16-connect-with-code.png).
10. Two-device test, owner A and guest B, each in its own Chrome. B (fresh) turned Labs on, tapped Home ⎇, set a name, pasted A's code and tapped Join. B showed "Read this back to them" with its answer code (J1/35-guest-join-sheet.png, J1/36-guest-answer-code.png). A pasted the answer and tapped Connect, which showed "Step 3 · check these letters match theirs: MB9MY". B showed the same MB9MY. A tapped They match. A then read "● Live · 1 person here" with Sam listed as Editor, and B is inside Project 1 with Mia's chip (J1/37-owner-sas-step.png, J1/38-guest-sas.png, J1/39-owner-after-match.png, J1/40-guest-after-match.png). It works.
11. Tapped Done. The editor while live shows nothing but the 28px person+, which is pixel-identical to the not-shared state (J1/20-editor-while-sharing.png; the zoom crops J1/20b-person-plus-zoom-LIVE.png and J1/24b-person-plus-zoom.png have a PIL difference bbox of None). The cog reopens straight to Friends ("● Live · waiting for someone", J1/21-cog-again-while-sharing.png).
12. Stop sharing asks for confirmation with plain words (J1/22-stop-sharing-confirm.png) and returns to "Not shared yet". Labs stays on and the person+ stays (J1/23-after-stop-sharing.png, J1/24-editor-after-stop.png). The gear (Sharing settings) has no off switch for the feature (J1/25-sharing-settings-gear.png).
13. Looked for the off switch. The path is ⤢ to Canvas, App settings…, then scroll 5.6 screens to "Live collaboration (preview)" (y 4246 of 4401, J1/27-app-settings-from-editor.png, J1/28-labs-in-editor-settings.png). From Home's cog it is 4.2 screens (J1/18-home-settings-top.png, J1/19-home-settings-labs.png). The word "Labs" appears nowhere in either Settings panel.
14. Home ⋯ on the project with Labs off: Open, Pin, Rename, Duplicate, Save as template/element, Select, Export video, Save project file, Delete. No Share (J1/30-home-card-menu-labs-off.png). With Labs on, "Share live…" appears. It opened the editor, then a LIGHT-themed name prompt over the dark editor (J1/33-share-live-from-home.png), then the bottom-sheet Share card, not the Friends block (J1/34-share-live-from-home-after-name.png). Home also gains a ⎇ button (J1/31-home-labs-on.png).
15. Selected a layer: the phone top bar becomes the layer tools, and both the cog and the person+ are display:none (J1/42-layer-selected-not-editing.png).
16. Opened the copied link as an iPhone Safari friend (UA override, fresh device). The first card says "Open this in your FreeMotion app": 1 Copy invite, 2 Open FreeMotion from your Home Screen, 3 turn it on in Settings → Labs, 4 tap ⎇. "Join here in Safari instead" leads to a second card, "Turn on Live collaboration to join" (J1/44-friend-opens-link-iphone-safari.png, J1/45-friend-join-here-safari.png).
works: With Labs off, Canvas settings (the cog) still shows a Friends bar that says 'Share it live with friends'. Opening it explains the feature and turns it on with one switch, right there, with no trip to Settings (J1/04, J1/06). This is the right shape, so keep it.

From the switch to something sendable takes 3 taps plus a name: switch, Start sharing, type a name, Continue. Copy link, Share…, QR and the short code with Copy all fit on the first screen at 390x844 without scrolling (J1/11).
Copy link really put the invite link on the clipboard and said 'Link copied' (J1/13). QR draws a clean 196px code with a one-line instruction (J1/14).

The long connection-code route works end to end between two separate browsers: offer, answer, a matching 5-letter check (MB9MY on both screens), then '● Live · 1 person here' with the friend listed as Editor, and the friend inside the project with the owner's chip (J1/37–40). The steps are numbered and readable.
Opening the Friends block never starts sharing; only Start sharing does. The cog remembers Friends and reopens it showing the live state (J1/21).
Stop sharing has a plain-language confirmation ('Everyone here keeps their own copy. The codes you have handed out stop working.') and returns cleanly to 'Not shared yet' (J1/22, J1/23).
An empty name gets a clear inline error ('Type a name so people know who you are.').
Every tap target I pressed in the share flow was actually on top at its centre (elementFromPoint), with nothing covered or unreachable. Buttons are 42–50px tall, apart from the 28px person+.

findings.title: With Labs off, the editor has no visible way to share; the only way in is behind the cog labelled 'Canvas settings'
findings.what_happens: On a fresh install with a new project, the phone top bar shows back, name, version, ?, notes, cog and ↑. The ↑ looks like the iPhone Share icon, but it opens the Export dialog (format, resolution, quality) with no mention of sharing live. Home's ⋯ menu has no Share item while Labs is off. The only way in is to open the cog (aria 'Canvas settings') and notice the Friends bar above the canvas card.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Someone who wants to send a project to a friend taps the Share-shaped ↑ and lands in Export. A gear reads as settings, not sharing. This is his own complaint: 'I don't know if you've buried it all in a deeper setting'. The feature exists, but nothing on the editor or on Home points to it.
findings.evidence: J1/03-editor-new-project.png (top bar, Labs off, no #btn-share); J1/05-export-tapped.png (↑ opens #export-dialog, no share wording); J1/30-home-card-menu-labs-off.png (⋯ menu has no Share); J1/04-canvas-settings.png (Friends bar only inside the cog). index.html:394 (#m-settings aria-label 'Canvas settings'), index.html:395 (#m-export path 'M12 15V4M8 8l4-4 4 4M6 20h12', an up-arrow out of a tray); js/collab-ui.js:3916-3924 (the share button only exists once Labs is on); js/home.js:1356-1361 ('Share live…' only when labsOn()).
findings.suggested_fix: Give the phone a share entry that is always visible, whatever the Labs setting. Options: (a) the stage's person+ is always shown and, with Labs off, opens the same Friends block with the explanation and switch (drawLabsOff already exists); (b) a 'Share live with a friend' row at the top of the Export dialog that opens Friends; (c) 'Share live…' in Home ⋯ always, opening the Labs-off explanation when off. Draw these for him first.

findings.title: You can turn it on in one tap, but there is no off switch anywhere near it, and every hint points to a 'Settings → Labs' that does not exist
findings.what_happens: Flipping the switch in the Friends block makes the switch disappear, along with the sentence 'you can turn it off again in Settings → Labs'. After that, neither the Friends block, the gear's Sharing settings nor Stop sharing turns the feature off. Stop sharing leaves Labs on, and the person+ stays on the stage of every project and ⎇ on Home. The real switch is 'Live collaboration (preview)' at the very bottom of App settings: 5.6 screens down from the editor (y 4246 of 4401), 4.2 screens down from Home, below 24 other rows including seven diagnostic report boxes ('Your last scrub', 'A clip with no picture', …). No heading or label in Settings contains the word 'Labs'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: This is exactly what he reported: 'there's a switch to turn it on, but you can never turn it off on any project ever'. The one place that told them where the off switch lives names a section that is not labelled anywhere, and the switch sits under debug reports a normal user never scrolls past.
findings.evidence: J1/07-friends-labs-on-idle.png (the switch is gone after turning on); J1/23-after-stop-sharing.png and J1/24-editor-after-stop.png (after Stop sharing: labs true, person+ still shown); J1/25-sharing-settings-gear.png (no feature off switch); J1/27-app-settings-from-editor.png and J1/28-labs-in-editor-settings.png (5.6 screens down); J1/19-home-settings-labs.png (4.2 screens down). Measured /\bLabs\b/.test(settingsPanel.innerText) === false. js/collab-ui.js:1110 (the 'Settings → Labs' sentence), :1113 (switchRow only in drawLabsOff); js/settings.js:907-990 (the Labs group is built last, after the Reports).
findings.suggested_fix: Keep a 'Live collaboration' on/off row inside the Friends block at all times, for example at the foot of the idle and live views or inside the gear's Sharing settings. Label the Settings group 'Labs', or rename every 'Settings → Labs' mention to the real row name. Move the collaboration group above the diagnostic Reports.

findings.title: Nothing on the editor says the project is live: the 'sharing' and 'not sharing' person+ buttons are pixel-identical
findings.what_happens: After Start sharing and Done, the editor shows only a 28×28 person+ in the stage's top-left corner. It is the same icon, size and place as when nothing is shared (a PIL diff of the two crops is empty). The only word that sharing started is a 3.6 s toast, which lands on top of the short code. The live state only shows inside the cog, as '● Live · waiting for someone'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: After tapping Done, a first-timer cannot tell whether their project is open to others, whether the link still works, or whether they need to stop it. It also feeds the 'can't turn it off' feeling: nothing visible says anything is on.
findings.evidence: J1/20-editor-while-sharing.png vs J1/24-editor-after-stop.png; zoom crops J1/20b-person-plus-zoom-LIVE.png and J1/24b-person-plus-zoom.png (ImageChops.difference bbox None, max 0). #collab-people and #btn-share are both [8,105,28,28]. styles.css:10409 (.collab-people.cp-invite width 28px); js/collab-ui.js:1044 (the only notice, a toast).
findings.suggested_fix: While a room is live and nobody has joined yet, show a small '● Live' pill or a coloured ring on the stage chip, plus the Friends bar's own words. Draw options for him.

findings.title: The screens are written for engineers: relays, 'free connection service', PeerJS/EMQX/HiveMQ, 'address lookup'
findings.what_happens: The turn-on screen's biggest block of text is a 7-line paragraph naming five companies and 'relays' and 'address lookup' (J1/06). The same paragraph repeats at the bottom of the share panel (J1/15). The code option is sold as 'No relay at all — you send them a long code and they send one back'. The status line reads 'Starting the relay…' or 'Couldn't reach the free connection service'. The Settings switch description repeats it all again.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: He asked that it 'actually makes sense for someone who doesn't know how to use it'. A first-timer does not know what a relay is and cannot use it to choose between 'Copy link' and 'Connect with a code instead'. The privacy text drowns the one sentence that matters, which is what sharing does.
findings.evidence: J1/06-friends-labs-off.png, J1/15-share-panel-bottom.png, J1/19-home-settings-labs.png. js/collab-ui.js:1564 (PRIVACY_LINE), :1593-1605 (relayLine wording), js/settings.js:980-982 (switch description).
findings.suggested_fix: Lead with plain words, for example 'Send a link — your friend opens it and you edit together'. Keep the disclosure behind a one-line 'What gets sent? ›' toggle. Rename 'Connect with a code instead / No relay at all' to something like 'Link not working? Swap codes instead'.

findings.title: What the friend gets when they tap the link: two cards of instructions that assume the app is installed and point to a 'Labs' that doesn't exist
findings.what_happens: Opening the copied link as iPhone Safari on a fresh device shows 'Open this in your FreeMotion app': 1 Tap Copy invite, 2 Open FreeMotion from your Home Screen, 3 turn it on in Settings → Labs, 4 tap ⎇ (Join a live project), then Paste. A friend who has never installed FreeMotion cannot do step 2. 'Join here in Safari instead' leads to a second card, 'Turn on Live collaboration to join'. The ⎇ glyph means nothing to a newcomer.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The owner's goal is 'send it to my friend and have it work'. The thing they sent lands on a card written for someone who already has the app and knows the menus. This overlaps the guest journey, but it is where J1's result ends up.
findings.evidence: J1/44-friend-opens-link-iphone-safari.png, J1/45-friend-join-here-safari.png. js/collab-ui.js:3817-3839 (landingCard steps), :3844-3858 (labsCard); js/collab-ui.js:3973 (⎇ glyph on #hm-join-btn).
findings.suggested_fix: Make 'Join here' the primary button for a friend without the app, or word step 2 as 'If you have FreeMotion on your Home Screen…'. Replace 'Settings → Labs' with the switch itself; the labsCard already turns it on in one tap. Give the Home join button a recognisable icon or word ('Join').

findings.title: The 'Keep FreeMotion open' toast covers the short code the moment it appears
findings.what_happens: Right after Start sharing on a phone, the toast sits over the short-code box and the relay line for 3.6 s. This is the moment the user wants to read or copy the code.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The one thing to send is hidden right when they reach for it.
findings.evidence: J1/11-share-panel-top.png and J1/34-share-live-from-home-after-name.png. Measured toast rect [97.5,533,195,67] over #collab-room-code [44,532,229,44]. js/collab-ui.js:1044.
findings.suggested_fix: Say it inside the panel as a one-line note under the invite block, or place the toast above the invite block or at the top of the screen while a collab panel is up.

findings.title: Name prompt: Return does nothing, 'cursor' on a phone, Cancel silently abandons sharing, and the preview colour doesn't match the pick
findings.what_happens: With 'Mia' typed, pressing Return leaves the card up and saves no profile (measured). The text says the name shows 'beside your cursor', and a phone has no cursor. Cancel, or a tap on the dim backdrop, returns to 'Not shared yet' with no word that a name is needed to share. The idle row shows a red dot (PALETTE[0]) while the prompt pre-selects a random colour (orange in J1/08).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: On an iPhone the natural finish is the keyboard's return key, and here it does nothing. Tapping outside to dismiss the keyboard cancels the whole share without explanation.
findings.evidence: J1/08-profile-prompt.png, J1/09-after-profile-cancel.png, J1/10-profile-typed-return.png (after Return: card up, getProfile() null). js/collab-ui.js:179-235 (no Enter handler), :189 ('beside your cursor'), :1077 (idle dot uses PALETTE[0]), :198 (random pick).
findings.suggested_fix: Make Enter press Continue. Word it as 'Your name and colour show on the other person's screen'. Pre-select the same colour the idle row shows. On Cancel from Start sharing, show one line such as 'Add a name to start sharing'.

findings.title: The idle Friends block uses developer wording and never says what Start sharing gives you
findings.what_happens: The idle block shows 'You / You — pick the name and colour others will see' (the word You twice), 'Start sharing', then 'Opening this never shares anything by itself.' Nothing says that Start sharing makes a link or code to send.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: 'Opening this never shares…' answers a question only a developer would ask. What a first-timer needs is 'you'll get a link to send your friend'.
findings.evidence: J1/07-friends-labs-on-idle.png. js/collab-ui.js:1080, :1093.
findings.suggested_fix: Replace the hint with 'You'll get a link, a QR and a short code to send'. Drop the doubled 'You'.

findings.title: The Home ⋯ 'Share live…' route shows a different share surface, and its name prompt draws in the light theme over the dark editor
findings.what_happens: Home ⋯ 'Share live…' opens the project, then shows the name prompt with scrim.collab-light = true even though Home is closed (a white sheet over the dark editor), then the bottom-sheet Share card. The cog route shows the Friends block instead. The same task gives two different-looking screens on the phone.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Two looks for one feature make it feel unfinished. The white card over the dark editor looks like a glitch.
findings.evidence: J1/33-share-live-from-home.png (measured {light:true, homeOpen:false}); J1/34-share-live-from-home-after-name.png (#collab-share card) vs J1/11 (Friends block). js/home.js:1357-1360 (setTimeout 260 → FM.collab.ui.share()); js/collab-ui.js:128-131 (light decided at open time while Home is still fading).
findings.suggested_fix: On a phone, route 'Share live…' through U.openPeople, which opens the Friends block, and have the Friends block's Start sharing raise the prompt. Or decide collab-light after the Home close finishes.

findings.title: The share entry vanishes whenever a layer is selected
findings.what_happens: After adding a text layer, the phone top bar becomes the layer tools (duplicate, delete, ⋯). The cog is gone and the stage person+ is display:none. Friends cannot be reached until the user deselects.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Right after adding something, which is the usual state, a first-timer looking for sharing finds neither door.
findings.evidence: J1/42-layer-selected-not-editing.png; measured #btn-share display 'none', #m-settings not visible.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep a Friends or person+ entry in the layer-mode top bar or its ⋯ menu, or leave the stage chip visible while a layer is selected.

findings.title: The person+ tap target is 28×28
findings.what_happens: The stage's share / people button measures 28×28 CSS px at [8,105], well under the 44px touch minimum. It sits in a corner that is easy to miss.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: It is small and easy to miss or mis-tap, and it is the main 'invite' door once Labs is on.
findings.evidence: J1/24b-person-plus-zoom.png; styles.css:10409 (.collab-people.cp-invite width 28px).
findings.suggested_fix: Grow the hit area to 44px with padding while keeping the drawn size, or draw a larger chip.

findings.title: Copy link says 'Link copied' even while the panel says the connection service is unreachable; the fallback is far below the fold
findings.what_happens: With the relay unreachable (always the case on localhost; on a phone it happens on a blocked network), Copy link is still the highlighted button and toasts 'Link copied'. The red line says 'use Connect with a code below', but that row is about 400px further down the scroller.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: They send a link that cannot connect, and the only warning is a red sentence they may not read.
findings.evidence: J1/13-after-copy-link.png (toast 'Link copied' over the red warning); J1/15-share-panel-bottom.png (the 'Connect with a code instead' row is at the bottom). js/collab-ui.js:1596, :1625.
findings.suggested_fix: When the relay is unreachable, make 'Connect with a code' the highlighted button inside the invite block and grey out Copy link, or add a caution to it.

findings.title: Share-panel order and code step: Comments sits above the invite block, and the long-code step has only 'Copy code'
findings.what_happens: The first thing under your name is 'Comments — Leave a note about the edit for everyone' before 'Invite with a link or a code'. In Connect with a code, Step 1 offers only Copy code, with no Share…, so sending means copy, switch app, paste.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The action they came for is second in the list. The long code is the hardest thing to send, and it has the fewest ways to send it.
findings.evidence: J1/11-share-panel-top.png, J1/16-connect-with-code.png. js/collab-ui.js:1234 (commentsRow appended before the invite block), :2081-2084 (Copy code only).
findings.suggested_fix: Put the invite block directly under the people list. Add a Share… button (navigator.share with the code as text) beside Copy code.

journeys.journey: J2: "My friend sent me something, how do I get in?" This is the friend's side on a phone (390x844, iPhone notch emulated) on a fresh device with Labs off, the default. I covered all three things a friend can receive: an invite link, a short room code and a long connection code. I walked the connection-code route for real between two separate headless Chromes (owner and guest) with no relay. The link and short-code relay route is refused on localhost by design, so for that route I judged the steps up to the refusal from the screens and the rest from the code.
journeys.walked:
All screenshots are under /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ezrasmith-Claude-FreeMotion/fde0eeaf-7d73-45b8-9f83-7761553e344d/scratchpad/a967/j2/. My driver is drv.py/common.py in that folder: two Chromes, Android or iPhone user agent, touch and hover:none turned on.
1. Fresh phone, Labs off, Home. The only header buttons are search, Select and the cog. There is no Join button (#hm-join-btn absent). See 01-home-fresh-labs-off.png.
2. Home cog → Settings. There is no heading called "Labs" anywhere (innerText has no "Labs"). "Live collaboration (preview)" is the last card: 3448px down a 3694px scroller, 4.6 screens, below six diagnostic rows ("Your last export/playback/project open/scrub/Back…", "A clip with no picture"). See 02-settings-open.png and 03-settings-live-collab-row.png. Flipping it reveals Join…, Test connection and Codes only (04-settings-labs-on.png). Home then gains a ⎇ glyph button (05-home-labs-on.png, zoom 05b-home-join-glyph-zoom.png).
3. Invite link on an Android phone, Labs off: index.html#j=<44>. The fragment was stripped from the address bar and the "Turn on Live collaboration to join" card appeared (10-link-android-labs-off.png). Turn on → "What should others see?" name/colour (11-link-android-profile-prompt.png) → Join sheet prefilled with the link, "Tap Join to connect to this project." (12-link-android-join-sheet-prefilled.png) → Join. On localhost the relay is refused, so it showed "Couldn't reach the free connection service." with a [Connect with a code instead] button (13-link-android-join-relay-refused.png). Tapping that button only swaps the text (14-link-android-connect-with-code-instead.png).
4. The same link as iPhone Safari: the landing card "Open this in your FreeMotion app", steps 1–4, with "Copy invite" as the primary button (15-link-iphone-safari-landing.png, 16-link-iphone-after-copy.png). "Join here in Safari instead" → labs card (17-link-iphone-join-here-labs-card.png). "Not now" → the card closes, fm.pendingJoin is deleted and there is still no Join anywhere (18-link-iphone-after-not-now.png).
5. Inside a project with Labs off: cog → Canvas settings shows a Friends bar, "Share it live with friends" (20-editor-labs-off.png, 21-canvas-settings-labs-off.png). Opening it gives "Work on this with friends" and a switch (22-friends-block-labs-off.png). Switching it on shows "Share 'Untitled'", [Set up…], [Start sharing], "New people join as Editor", [Done]. There is no Join (23-friends-block-labs-on-idle.png).
6. Connection-code exchange with two real browsers:
 - Owner: cog → Friends → switch on → Start sharing → name "Ezra" (30-owner-sharing-main.png) → Connect with a code instead → a 210-character FM1 code (31-owner-code-step.png).
 - Guest: Settings switch → Home ⎇ → name "Sam" → pasted the code → Join (32-guest-join-sheet-code-pasted.png). The answer code appeared under "READ THIS BACK TO THEM" with status "Connecting…" (33-guest-answer-code.png).
 - Owner pasted it → Connect → "Step 3 · check these letters match theirs" SWKP8 (34-owner-check-letters.png). The guest showed the same SWKP8 (35-guest-letters.png).
 - They match → the guest landed in the editor with toast "You're in — this copy stays in sync" (36-guest-in-editor.png). Owner got "Sam joined" (37, 38).
7. Once in: the guest added a text layer and the owner received it; the owner added a rectangle and the guest received it within about 2s, with the owner's selection outline and playhead marked "E" in their colour (60, 61, 62). The guest's only on-screen sign of the session is a 31x28px "E" button (aria "Here: Ezra") in the stage corner (90-guest-editor-after-toast-gone.png). Tapping it opens "Shared with you · Live · You're an Editor · Ezra Owner [Follow] · Comments · [Leave] [Done]" (39-guest-people-panel.png).
8. Back arrow to Home mid-session: still connected. The card reads SHARED and "Shared by Ezra · live now", and reopening it resumes (63, 65, 66). Card ⋯ offers Keep as my own copy and Leave & delete (91-guest-home-card-menu.png).
9. Leave: chip → Leave → "Leave this project? … [Cancel] [Keep my own copy]" → toast "You left — this is now your own copy" (70, 71, 73). The owner's chip just vanished, and there was no "Sam left" (72).
10. Owner Stop sharing while the guest was in: the guest got a toast and a red banner that is cut off at "This live session has ended — your..." (80, 81).
11. Guest switched Live collaboration off in Settings mid-session: it left silently with no confirm and no toast, and the owner was not told (82, 83).
12. Timing test: guest answer shown, owner pastes 30s later. At t+19s the guest showed "Connecting…"; at t+23s "They did not answer — ask for a fresh code." (50-guest-after-30s-waiting-for-owner.png). The owner pasting at t+30s got "They did not answer — try a fresh code." (51-owner-pastes-late-answer.png).
13. Paste tolerance (s11/s12): a line-wrapped, lowercased or space-separated code is accepted. A code pasted with message text in front is rejected ("does not look like an invite link or a code").
works: The connection-code exchange really works device to device with no server. Two separate browsers paired, both screens showed the same five letters, and the guest landed in the editor holding the owner's project (33-36). Keep the mechanism.

Live sync is real both ways and quick. The guest's text layer reached the owner, and the owner's rectangle reached the guest in about 2s. The guest also sees the owner's selection outline and playhead marked with their initial in their colour (62-guest-sees-owner-shape.png).

Invite link on Android/Chrome with Labs off: the #j= is taken off the address bar straight away, and the friend gets one plain card, 'Turn on Live collaboration to join' [Turn on]. Name and colour come next, then the Join sheet already filled in and waiting for a single tap. That is four taps with no hunting (10, 11, 12).
The guest panel is clear and complete: 'Shared with you · Live · You're an Editor', the owner with Follow, Comments, and Leave/Done (39-guest-people-panel.png).
Leave works and says what happened. The confirm explains the copy stays, the toast reads 'You left — this is now your own copy', and the Home card becomes an ordinary project (70, 71, 73).

The Home card for a shared copy is good: a SHARED badge, 'Shared by Ezra · live now', and ⋯ → Keep as my own copy / Leave & delete (63, 91). Going back to Home mid-session keeps the connection, and reopening the card resumes it (63-65).
When the owner stops sharing, the guest is told at once by a toast and a banner, and keeps the copy (80).
Relay failure is not a dead end: it offers the code route in the same sheet (13).
The code reader is forgiving about line wraps, lowercase and spaces (s12 output).

findings.title: The guest has only 20 seconds to get their answer code back to the owner, so a real code exchange almost always fails
findings.what_happens: The guest pastes the owner's code and taps Join. Their answer code appears with 'Connecting…'. If the owner hasn't pasted it and tapped Connect within 20 seconds, the guest's sheet flips to 'They did not answer — ask for a fresh code.' When the owner then pastes the answer, they get 'They did not answer — try a fresh code.' Both have to start over, and the stale answer code (with its Copy button) stays on the guest's sheet.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The screens tell the friend to copy the code, send it back and wait for it to be pasted. That means switching to a messaging app, sending, the owner opening the message, copying, switching back, pasting and tapping Connect. That takes well over 20 seconds even for two people sitting side by side, and far longer for friends in different places. The failure message blames the owner ('They did not answer'), not the clock, so they will just repeat it and fail again. This is also the route the app sends people to when relays fail.
findings.evidence: Measured in s7_slow.py with two real browsers: t+10s and t+19s after the answer appeared, 'Connecting…'; t+23s, 'They did not answer — ask for a fresh code.'; owner pasting at t+30s got note 'They did not answer — try a fresh code.' Screens: 50-guest-after-30s-waiting-for-owner.png, 51-owner-pastes-late-answer.png. Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3179 `return openedWithin(link);` runs right after acceptOffer produces the answer, and openedWithin (collab-ui.js:663-672) races ICE_CONNECT = 20000 (js/collab-core.js:50). The owner side has the same clock after Connect (collab-ui.js:2185), which is fine there.
findings.suggested_fix: On the guest side, do not start the 20s ICE clock while the answer is waiting to be pasted. Wait for the owner's end to start connecting (for example the peer connection's iceConnectionState leaving 'new', or ~10 minutes as an outer limit), then apply the 20s. Say 'Waiting for Ezra to paste your code…' with Cancel. On failure, clear the dead answer code and say plainly that the code timed out.

findings.title: With Labs off there is nowhere on Home to paste a code, and the switch is the last row of Settings, 4.6 screens down
findings.what_happens: A fresh friend who was sent a short code or a long connection code opens FreeMotion. Home has search, Select and the cog, and no Join. The ⎇ Join button is only created once Live collaboration is switched on. Home cog → Settings: the 'Live collaboration (preview)' switch is the very last card, below six diagnostic 'Your last …' rows and 'A clip with no picture'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: They are holding a code and the app shows no place to put it and no hint that such a place exists. Only someone who already knows to scroll to the bottom of Settings will find it. This is exactly Ezra's 'I don't know if you've buried it all in a deeper setting'.
findings.evidence: 01-home-fresh-labs-off.png (probe: join:false, buttons = search, Select, Settings). 03-settings-live-collab-row.png: row offset 3448px of a 3694px scroller in a 753px viewport, 4.6 screens down. Settings labels list ends '…Your last Back from an effects category, A clip with no picture, Live collaboration (preview)'. Cause: the Join button is made only in U.install (js/collab-ui.js:3998), which U.syncLabs calls only when labsOn (collab-ui.js:4054). The switch is appended last (js/settings.js:980).
findings.suggested_fix: Put a Join entry on Home always. With Labs off, tapping it shows the same one-tap 'Turn on Live collaboration to join' card the invite link already uses (labsCard), then the Join sheet. Move the Live collaboration group above the diagnostic Reports rows in Settings.

findings.title: Every instruction says 'Settings → Labs', but Settings has no Labs heading
findings.what_happens: The invite card, the iPhone landing card, the Friends block and the Codes-only message all send the user to 'Settings → Labs'. Settings has no section or label called Labs. The row is titled 'Live collaboration (preview)', with no group title.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: They open Settings looking for 'Labs', scroll a long panel full of report boxes, and never see the word. The directions they were given do not match the screen.
findings.evidence: Probe on the open Settings panel: /\bLabs\b/.test(innerText) === false. References: js/collab-ui.js:3828 (landing step 3), 3849 (labs card), the drawLabsOff text 'you can turn it off again in Settings → Labs' (22-friends-block-labs-off.png), and 2600 / relayJoin's Codes-only line.
findings.suggested_fix: Either give the group a visible 'Labs' heading in Settings, or change every sentence to what is really there, e.g. 'Settings → Live collaboration (at the bottom)'. The wording fix alone is text-only.

findings.title: The Home Join button is a bare '⎇' keyboard glyph with no word
findings.what_happens: With Labs on, Home gains a 38px round button holding the Unicode character U+2387 (the 'alternative key' symbol). There is no label. The iPhone landing card tells people to 'tap ⎇ (Join a live project)'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The glyph looks like a keyboard modifier or a squiggle, not 'join'. A friend told to find 'Join' will not recognise it, and the app draws its other icons (see v17.05's drawn ✕), so this one also looks unfinished.
findings.evidence: 05-home-labs-on.png and the zoom 05b-home-join-glyph-zoom.png (rect 158,54,38x38; font falls back to Arial). Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3975 `b.textContent = '⎇'`; landing text js/collab-ui.js:3829.
findings.suggested_fix: A drawn icon plus the word 'Join' (or a 'Join' pill like 'Select'), and update the landing-card step to match. Show options first.

findings.title: The iPhone invite card assumes the friend already has FreeMotion installed and pushes them into a dead end
findings.what_happens: A friend opens the invite link on an iPhone (Safari) and gets 'Open this in your FreeMotion app'. The steps are Copy invite → 'Open FreeMotion from your Home Screen' → turn on Labs → tap ⎇ → Paste. The big blue button is 'Copy invite'. The route that actually works for them, 'Join here in Safari instead', is the grey secondary button, framed by 'Joining in Safari keeps this copy separate from your FreeMotion app.'
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Most friends receiving an invite have never had FreeMotion, so there is nothing on their Home Screen to open. The recommended path ends at a step they cannot do, with no word on installing, and the working option is presented as the second-best, storage-jargon choice.
findings.evidence: 15-link-iphone-safari-landing.png and 16-link-iphone-after-copy.png (iPhone user agent, fresh profile, isIosBrowser() true, Labs off). Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3800 (always landing first on iOS) and 3817-3840 (card copy and button order).
findings.suggested_fix: When this Safari storage has never been used for FreeMotion (no projects, no profile), lead with 'Join now' and offer 'Add FreeMotion to your Home Screen' as an optional after-step. Only show 'open your installed app' first when this browser looks like a returning user. Show options before changing.

findings.title: The Friends block inside a project only lets you share; it has no way to join someone else's project
findings.what_happens: On a phone the only collaboration door inside a project is cog → Friends ('Share it live with friends'). Opened with Labs off, it offers a switch. Once on, it shows 'Share "Untitled"', [Set up…], [Start sharing], 'New people join as Editor', [Done]. There is nothing for 'I've been sent a link/code'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: A friend who got a code and looks in the obvious 'Friends' place finds only Start sharing. Tapping it makes their own project live and shows them a link and code, the opposite of what they wanted, and they still have not joined.
findings.evidence: 22-friends-block-labs-off.png, 23-friends-block-labs-on-idle.png; button list ['Set up…','Start sharing','Editor ▾','Done']. Cause: drawFriendsIdle js/collab-ui.js:1065-1101 and the bar text in U.friendsBar ('Share it live with friends').
findings.suggested_fix: Add a 'Got an invite? Join with a link or code' row to the idle Friends block (and to its Labs-off view) that opens the Join sheet.

findings.title: The guest's answer code says 'Read this back to them' and 'Connecting…' when it must be copied, sent and pasted
findings.what_happens: After Join, the guest sees a 143–179-character code under 'READ THIS BACK TO THEM', then five letters under 'READ THESE LETTERS BACK TO THEM', while the status says 'Connecting…'. The Join button stays bright blue although it is disabled.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Nobody can read a 150-character code aloud. The screen never says 'send this to them, they paste it in Step 2', and 'Connecting…' suggests the app is doing the work, so they wait. Combined with the 20-second clock, they are the reason it fails without knowing it.
findings.evidence: 33-guest-answer-code.png, 35-guest-letters.png. Cause: js/collab-ui.js:2640 label, 3175 STEPS[1] 'Connecting…'. No :disabled style exists for .fm-ask-ok / .cj-go in styles.css (grep empty).
findings.suggested_fix: Label the code 'Send this code back to Ezra — they paste it in Step 2', add a Share… button beside Copy code, set the status to 'Waiting for Ezra to paste your code…', and give disabled buttons a visibly disabled look.

findings.title: Once in, the guest's only sign of the session is a 28px initial, and Leave is hidden behind it
findings.what_happens: After the 3-second toast, the guest's editor looks like any of their own projects: the same 'Untitled' title and top bar. The only difference is a 31x28px circle with 'E' in the stage corner (aria 'Here: Ezra'). Leave lives behind that circle, or cog → Friends bar, or Home card ⋯ → Leave & delete.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: They cannot tell at a glance whose project this is, that it is live, or who is in it, and nothing hints that the tiny letter opens the people and Leave. 'How do I get out?' has no visible answer, and the target is under the 44px touch minimum.
findings.evidence: 36-guest-in-editor.png, 90-guest-editor-after-toast-gone.png; chip measured 31x28 at (8,105). Leave found only via the chip (39-guest-people-panel.png) or Home ⋯ (91-guest-home-card-menu.png).
findings.suggested_fix: While joined, show a small persistent pill such as 'Live · Ezra's project' (tap → the guest panel with Leave), or widen the chip to carry the word 'Live' and the owner's name. Keep the chip's tap target at 44px or more.

findings.title: Switching Live collaboration off mid-session leaves silently, and the owner is never told someone left
findings.what_happens: A guest in a session goes to Settings and turns 'Live collaboration (preview)' off, perhaps just to see what it does. The session ends immediately with no confirm and no toast; the last toast still reads 'You're in'. On the owner's side, a guest leaving (by Leave or by this switch) just makes their chip vanish, with no 'Sam left'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Neither person learns what happened. The guest does not know they left, and the owner sees a face disappear with no explanation.
findings.evidence: s10 output: after the switch, session:false with toast still 'You’re in — this copy stays in sync' (82-guest-turned-labs-off-mid-session.png, 83-guest-editor-after-labs-off.png); owner chip '' and toast still 'Sam joined' (72-owner-after-guest-left.png). Cause: js/collab-ui.js:4074 (C.leave with no toast/ask); owner link.onclose js/collab-ui.js:2218 (no toast).
findings.suggested_fix: If a session is live, confirm before turning the switch off ('This will leave Ezra's project — keep your copy?') and toast the result. On the owner's side, toast '<name> left'.

findings.title: 'Connect with a code instead' on the guest's failed join is a button that does nothing
findings.what_happens: When the relay cannot be reached, the Join sheet shows a full-width [Connect with a code instead] button. Tapping it only replaces the line with 'Ask them to tap Share → Connect with a code instead, then paste the long code they send you here.' On the owner's phone, 'Share' is an unlabelled person+ icon, and the option only appears after Start sharing.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: A button promises an action and then gives instructions for the other person, naming a control that has no such word on the phone.
findings.evidence: 13-link-android-join-relay-refused.png → 14-link-android-connect-with-code-instead.png. Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3006.
findings.suggested_fix: Show the instruction as text (not a button), and name the phone path: 'Ask them to tap the person+ on their video → Start sharing → Connect with a code instead'.

findings.title: 'Ended' banner is cut off on the phone
findings.what_happens: When the owner stops sharing, the guest's banner reads 'This live session has ended — your...', truncated mid-sentence. The guest panel then still says 'You're an Editor.' under 'Ended'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The half that is cut off ('your copy stays on this device') is the reassuring half.
findings.evidence: 80-guest-after-owner-stopped.png, 81-guest-friends-after-owner-stopped.png. Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3410-3412 has no phone short form, although the other banners have one (the isPhoneNow branches just below).
findings.suggested_fix: Give the phone a short form such as 'Session ended · your copy is kept', and hide the role line once the session has ended.

findings.title: Wording a first-timer can't use: 'cursor' on a phone, relay brand names, and a Join hint that omits the long code
findings.what_happens: Three bits of wording. The name prompt says 'Your name and colour show up beside your cursor', and phones have no cursor. The switch the friend must read to join says 'relays run by PeerJS, EMQX and HiveMQ, and Google and Cloudflare’s address lookup … Codes only skips them all'. The Settings 'Join a live project' hint says 'Paste an invite link, or type the short code somebody read you', with no mention of the long code.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: This is technical vocabulary at exactly the moment a newcomer decides whether to trust and turn on the feature, and the Join hint leaves out one of the three things they may have been sent.
findings.evidence: 11-link-android-profile-prompt.png (js/collab-ui.js:189); 03-settings-live-collab-row.png and 04-settings-labs-on.png (js/settings.js:980-983); js/settings.js:922.
findings.suggested_fix: '…show up next to what you're doing on their screen'. Put one plain sentence first ('Work on a project with friends on their own phones') with the privacy detail behind a 'How it connects' line. Change the hint to 'Paste the link or code they sent you'.

findings.title: Tapping 'Not now' on the invite card throws the invite away with no word
findings.what_happens: Opening an invite link with Labs off, tapping 'Not now' (or Cancel on the name prompt, or Cancel on the prefilled Join sheet) deletes the stored invite (fm.pendingJoin). With Labs still off, the app then has no place to paste it later either.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: A newcomer who taps 'Not now' to look around first has lost the invite silently. They must find the message and tap the link again, and nothing says so.
findings.evidence: s3_ios output after Not now: pending: null, join: false (18-link-iphone-after-not-now.png). Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3847 labs card onclose clears it; U.resumePendingJoin clears it on a cancelled profile; drawJoin onclose clears it when fromPending.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep the invite for its normal lifetime after 'Not now', and offer it again from the Home Join entry (see the Home Join finding), or at least say 'Tap the link again when you're ready'.

findings.title: A code pasted with message text in front of it is rejected
findings.what_happens: If the friend copies a whole chat bubble such as 'Here is the code: FM1-…', the Join sheet says 'That does not look like an invite link or a code.' An invite link inside text works, because the link reader looks for the '#'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Copying the whole message is the natural gesture in most messaging apps, and the error suggests the code itself is wrong.
findings.evidence: s11_paste.py: classify('Here is the code: ' + code) → null. Cause: js/collab-signal.js:115 isConnCode requires the text to start with FM1.
findings.suggested_fix: Find 'FM1' anywhere in the pasted text and read from there, as the link reader does with '#'.

findings.title: Owner's letter check shows two blue primary buttons at once
findings.what_happens: At Step 3, 'They match' appears in blue, and the old blue 'Connect' button stays directly underneath it, along with ‹ Back and the Stop sharing/Done foot.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The owner is the one letting the friend in, and it is unclear which blue button finishes the job.
findings.evidence: 34-owner-check-letters.png. Cause: confirmSas renders into the status under Step 2 (js/collab-ui.js:2201), and the Connect button (js/collab-ui.js:2095) is not hidden.
findings.suggested_fix: Hide or disable Connect once the letters step is showing.

journeys.journey: J3: "We're sharing — now how do I manage it and how do I TURN IT OFF?" The owner on a phone (390x844, touch emulation, 47px notch) with a shared project. Covers who is here, changing a role, removing someone, inviting more, the banner and people chip, the app going to the background or being killed, Stop sharing (does it really stop, does it come back by itself), what "off" means for another project that was shared once, and the Labs switch turned off while shared. The main question: why Ezra found "a switch to turn it on, but you can never turn it off on any project ever".
journeys.walked:
Everything was done in the real app at http://localhost:8777 with my own CDP drivers (drv.py, common.py, pair.py, s1–s17.py). They are phone-emulated Chromes that send real touch events at element centres; I checked what was under each tap with elementFromPoint. Screenshots are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ezrasmith-Claude-FreeMotion/fde0eeaf-7d73-45b8-9f83-7761553e344d/scratchpad/a967/j3/.
1. Home, then tapped the project card to open the editor. Labs is off and there is no share button (01-home.png, 02-editor-labs-off.png).
2. Tapped the cog (#m-settings): Canvas settings opens with a "Friends · Share it live with friends" bar on top (03). Tapped ⤢: "Work on this with friends", one switch, and the line "you can turn it off again in Settings → Labs" (04).
3. Tapped the switch. Labs came on and the block redrew as "Share 'Untitled' · Not shared yet · Start sharing". The switch count in the block went to 0 (05).
4. Tapped Start sharing. The profile prompt appeared; I typed a name and tapped Continue. The session went live, fm.collab.host.<pid> was written, and a toast said "Keep FreeMotion open…" (06, 07). Stop sharing is pinned in the foot at y 774–818.
5. Tapped Done. The editor looks exactly like it did before sharing (08): a 28px person+ in the stage corner, no banner. Went back to Home: the card shows a red LIVE badge (09).
6. Two projects: shared A, created B, opened B. A paused and kept its host record. B's Friends says "Not shared yet" and nothing mentions A (11). Home shows A with no badge (12). Opened A from Home and it re-armed by itself with the toast "Sharing is on again — people can reconnect" (13). A reload re-armed it again (14).
7. Stop: tapped the stage chip, which opens Friends big (15). Stop sharing → confirm (16) → "Sharing stopped" (17). The session ended and the host record was deleted. Reopening and reloading did NOT re-arm it.
8. Labs from the editor: cog (Friends was remembered big, so App settings… measured 0×0) → ⤢ on the Canvas bar → App settings… (19). The Labs switch label sits at y=4246 in a 5048px scroll with 753px visible (20). Turned it off while live: the session ended and the record was dropped, with no confirmation (21).
9. Shared A, opened B, turned Labs off in B, relaunched the browser on the same profile, turned Labs on, opened A: A re-armed with "Sharing is on again" (22). Then a cold launch with A last open: the app lands on Home, and A is already live again with a LIVE badge before anything was tapped (23). The toast had already gone by the time Home showed (47).
10. Home ⋯ menu on a live project and on a paused shared one: Open, Pin, Rename, Duplicate, "Share live…", Earlier versions… and so on. There is no Stop sharing (24, 46). On a never-shared project, "Share live…" armed sharing at once and opened the separate Share card (25-home-share-live-armed-card).
11. Two devices (two Chromes, no relay): owner "Connect with a code instead" (26); guest Home ⎇ → Join, pasted the code, got the answer code (27); the owner pasted it and tapped Connect. The Step 3 "They match" button was hidden under the pinned foot and my first tap landed on Done (28). After scrolling, "They match" worked (28b). The guest was in: "Sam joined", an S face on the owner's stage (29, 31). Role menu Editor/Commenter/Viewer/Follow/Remove… (32) → Viewer: the guest got "View only — ask for edit access" (33). Owner hidden: the guest's E face went grey (34). Remove… → confirm (35) → the guest got a red "removed" banner and the link and code rotated (36, 37).
12. Background and lock: freezing the owner page with Page.setWebLifecycleState did not break the link (inconclusive; 38–40). Killing the owner's Chrome, the way iOS kills a backgrounded app: after 40s the code-joined guest still said "● Live · shared with you", online=true, no banner, only a grey E (41). When the owner relaunched, it re-armed and said "people can reconnect", but Sam had no row and never came back (42, 43).
13. Sharing settings (gear): no off switch for the feature (44, 45).
works: Stop sharing, once found, is solid. It is pinned in the foot of the Friends block in every view (main, the gear's settings, the code step). The confirm is plain ('Everyone here keeps their own copy…'). It really stops: the session ends, fm.collab.host.<pid> is deleted, and reopening or reloading that project does NOT re-arm it (s6, 15–17).
The stage chip is a one-tap way to manage a live session: tapping #collab-people opens Canvas settings with Friends big, people list on top (15).

The people list and role menu work device to device. Editor/Commenter/Viewer/Follow/Remove… in one menu. Switching to Viewer reaches the guest at once, with the toast 'Ezra made you a Viewer' and the banner 'View only — ask for edit access' (32, 33).

Remove works and explains itself. The confirm says it is permanent for that device and that the link and code change. The guest gets 'You were removed…', and the owner's toast says the old link and code no longer work (35–37).
The faces chip shows who is here: the guest's initial, a playhead marker in their colour, and a grey face when that person is away or gone (31, 34, 41).
Home's red LIVE badge on the card of the project that is live right now (09, 23).
Turning Labs off while live really ends the CURRENT session and drops its host record, so that project does not come back (21).
The connection-code exchange works between two devices with no relay, including the five-letter match check (26–29).
The profile prompt (name plus eight colours) is simple and appears only once (06).

findings.title: The only on/off switch a phone user ever sees vanishes once it is turned on, and the way back points to a 'Settings → Labs' that does not exist
findings.what_happens: On a phone, the feature's switch lives in the cog → Friends (⤢) block while Labs is off. Tapping it turns Labs on and redraws the block as 'Start sharing' with no switch (0 switches measured), on this project and every other one. The only guidance is the line 'you can turn it off again in Settings → Labs'. In the editor, 'Settings' is the cog, which opens Canvas settings. The app's Settings sits behind 'App settings…', a button on the Canvas card that measures 0×0 whenever Friends is the big card (the cog remembers Friends). Inside Settings the word 'Labs' appears nowhere (0 matches). The switch is the row 'Live collaboration (preview)', 22nd of 28 rows, below developer diagnostics ('Your last scrub', 'A clip with no picture'), at y=4246 in a 5048px scroll with 753px visible. That is about 4.7 screens down, reached by cog → ⤢ Canvas → App settings… → scroll.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: This is exactly his complaint: 'there's a switch to turn it on, but you can never turn it off'. The switch he used is gone after one tap. The instructions name a place with no heading on screen, and 'Settings' on the editor means a different panel.
findings.evidence: 05-friends-after-switch-on.png (block after the switch: no switch), 04-friends-labs-off.png (the 'Settings → Labs' line), 19-settings-top.png, 20-settings-labs.png. Measured: switches=0 after flip; appset {w:0,h:0} with Friends big; set-body scrollHeight 5048 / clientHeight 753, label top 4246; hasLabsWord=false.
