findings.title: A project shared once keeps re-arming itself on every open and every cold launch, even behind Home, until Stop sharing is pressed inside that very project
findings.what_happens: Start sharing writes fm.collab.host.<pid>. Opening another project only PAUSES that one. Home then shows its card with no badge at all, and B's Friends says 'Not shared yet' with nothing about A. The moment A is opened again it goes live by itself: toast 'Sharing is on again — people can reconnect', session live, relay started. On a cold launch the app lands on Home, and the last-open shared project is ALREADY live again (LIVE badge) before he taps anything. The 2.6s toast fires under the launch splash and had gone (0px) by the time Home was visible. Home's ⋯ menu for a live or paused shared project offers 'Share live…' but no Stop sharing. The only way to stop is to open the project, which re-arms it first, then find Stop sharing in Friends.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: This is the other half of 'you can never turn it off on any project ever'. Nothing tells him which projects are still shared, stopping one requires switching it back on first, and the app switches it on again by itself on launch.
findings.evidence: 12-home-two-projects-A-paused.png (no badge on the paused shared project), 13-reopened-A-rearmed.png, 14-after-reload-home.png, 23-cold-launch-home-rearmed.png (Home at cold launch, project LIVE untouched), 47-cold-launch-toast-check.png, 24-home-menu-live-project.png, 46-home-menu-paused-shared.png. STATE after reopen: session:true, toasts ['Sharing is on again — people can reconnect']. Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3715-3759 (afterReset → resumeOpen → resumeHost re-arms whenever a host record exists; comment: 'a record means he never stopped'); js/home.js:1260-1270 (collabOf badges only the ACTIVE session, not a paused record); js/home.js:1356-1362 (menu offers Share live…, never Stop).
findings.suggested_fix: Make a paused shared project visible and stoppable from outside it: a 'SHARED · paused' badge plus a Stop sharing item in Home's ⋯ menu that drops the record without re-arming. Do not re-arm at boot while Home is showing, or ask first ('Carry on sharing "X"?'). A 'Shared projects' list in Settings with Stop on each row would answer 'which of my projects are on'.

findings.title: Turning Labs OFF does not turn off other projects that were shared: they come back live on the same link the next time Labs is on
findings.what_happens: Shared A, opened B (A paused, record kept), turned Labs off while in B. A's host record survived. Weeks later (relaunched browser, same storage) Labs was turned back on and A opened: A re-armed on its OLD room, link and code, with 'Sharing is on again — people can reconnect'. The code's own comment says 'AN END IS AN END… Stop sharing drops the room; so does this', but syncLabs only drops the room of the CURRENTLY active session.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The Labs switch is the master 'off' and it reads as a promise. Anyone holding A's old invite link can come back into a project he believes he switched off.
findings.evidence: s9.py output: 'labs off in B' hostRecords still ['fm.collab.host.p_…A']; after Labs back on and opening A: session:true, toast 'Sharing is on again'. Screenshot 22-A-rearms-after-labs-cycle.png. Cause: js/collab-ui.js:4070-4082 (only `if (C.active)` drops a room: dropRoom(pid) for the current session's pid); paused records under fm.collab.host.* are untouched.
findings.suggested_fix: When Labs goes off, drop every fm.collab.host.* record (and its offers), not just the active one. Or at least say which projects will resume and ask.

findings.title: While he is live and nobody has joined yet, the editor looks exactly as it does when nothing is shared
findings.what_happens: After Start sharing → Done, the stage shows the same 28px person+ circle it shows before sharing: the live chip wears the invite button's classes 'collab-people cp-invite'. There is no banner and no dot. The only in-editor cues are a 3.6s toast (which on first share covers the short invite code) and the Friends bar inside the cog dialog. The live state only becomes visible on Home (LIVE badge) or once somebody joins (their face).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: He cannot tell which projects are live from inside them. Together with the silent re-arming above, projects stay 'on' without him knowing, which feeds 'can never turn it off'.
findings.evidence: 08-editor-while-shared.png against 05 (background) and 02: the same person+ circle. STATE: chip {w:28,h:28,cls:'collab-people cp-invite'}, banner:null. 07-sharing-live-block.png (toast over the code). Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3927-3963 (the stage invite button deliberately IS the chip at rest); U.syncBanner js/collab-ui.js:3384-3459 returns hideBanner for an owner with no peers; afterArm toast js/collab-ui.js:1043-1044.
findings.suggested_fix: Give the owner a persistent live marker on the stage while sharing: a red dot or a 'Live' ring on the chip, or a small 'Live · waiting' pill. The toast should not cover the code.

findings.title: Inviting by code: the Step 3 'They match' button is hidden under the pinned foot, and a tap there hits Done and silently abandons the join
findings.what_happens: In the Friends block at 390x844, when the guest's answer is pasted and Connect tapped, Step 3 appears at the bottom of the scroll body. 'They match' measured top 753 / bottom 797 while the foot [Stop sharing][Done] starts at 762, so only a 9px sliver shows. elementFromPoint at the button's centre is 'cs-done accent'. My first tap there pressed Done: the block closed, and the guest never got in and was not told. The body did not scroll to reveal the new step (scrollTop 0, scrollHeight 602, clientHeight 463).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The one gate he must pass to let a friend in is covered by a button that closes the panel. The failure is silent on both phones.
findings.evidence: 28-owner-sas.png (buttons hidden under the foot), 28b-owner-sas-scrolled.png. Measured: {yes:{top:753,bottom:797}, foot:{top:762}, hitAtYes:'cs-done accent'}. Cause: js/collab-ui.js:2164-2178 (confirmSas appends into the status line at the end of the body), js/collab-ui.js:2076-2140 (drawCodeStep), and the foot pinned by the Friends block styles.
findings.suggested_fix: Scroll Step 3 into view when it appears, or make the foot's Done/Stop give way to the match buttons during the check. Closing the block mid-check should say what happened.

findings.title: When the owner's phone kills or locks the app, a guest who joined with a code is never told: they stay on 'Live' with no banner, and the owner's 'people can reconnect' is untrue for them
findings.what_happens: Paired a guest by connection code, then killed the owner's browser (what iOS does to a backgrounded app). After 40s the guest still showed '● Live · shared with you', session online=true, no banner, only a grey E face, and kept editing into nothing. The owner relaunched: the project re-armed with 'Sharing is on again — people can reconnect'. But the code-joined guest has no way back, is not even listed as an offline member in the owner's people list, and never reconnected.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: 'What happens when my phone locks?' The app's own answer ('the session pauses', 'people can reconnect') is wrong for the code route, which is the route that works with no relay. Both people think they are still sharing.
findings.evidence: 41-guest-owner-app-killed.png; s15 output at 5/15/40s: {online:true, people:['Ezra:off'], banner:null, fr:'● Live · shared with you'}. 42-owner-relaunch.png / 43-owner-block-after-relaunch.png: owner list shows only 'Ezra · You · Owner'. Cause: liveness (6s silence → close) is switched on only for relay joins and reconnects, js/collab-ui.js:3084, 3578, 3593. The code path guestJoin js/collab-ui.js:3141-3200 never calls s.setLiveness(true) (collab-session.js:1388-1397 explains why it is needed). Freezing the page (38–40) could not reproduce a lock in headless Chrome, so the lock case is inferred from the kill case plus the code.
findings.suggested_fix: Turn liveness on for code-joined guests too, so they get the 'Offline — the live link dropped' banner within about 6s. Make the owner's resume toast and people list honest about members who cannot come back (list them as 'joined with a code — send a new code').

findings.title: Turning Labs off while live ends everyone's session with no 'are you sure' and no visible feedback
findings.what_happens: The switch in Settings flips at once: C.end(), the room dropped, guests kicked, invite codes dead. Stop sharing asks first; this does not. No toast is seen, because Settings' scrim covers toasts.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The same destructive act gets a confirm on one path and none on the other, and he gets no word that sharing stopped.
findings.evidence: 21-labs-off-while-shared.png; s7 output after the tap: session:false, hostRecords:[] and no visible message. Cause: js/settings.js:984 (toggle applies immediately), js/collab-ui.js:4065-4086.
findings.suggested_fix: When a session is live, confirm first ('Turning this off stops sharing "X" for everyone'), and put the result on the row itself rather than in a hidden toast.

findings.title: Home ⋯ 'Share live…' starts sharing instantly and opens a different Share card; on a live project it still says 'Share live…' and never offers Stop
findings.what_happens: On a never-shared project, ⋯ → Share live… (then the profile prompt) armed sharing straight away (host record written, session live) and opened the separate #collab-share card rather than the Friends block. That contradicts the block's own promise 'Opening this never shares anything by itself', and phone users see two different share screens. On a project that is already live, the same menu still says 'Share live…', with no Stop sharing or 'Manage sharing'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: An ellipsis item that goes live without a Start step, and a menu that cannot turn off what it turned on.
findings.evidence: 25-home-share-live-armed-card.png; s11 output: session:true, hostRecords:[pid]. 24-home-menu-live-project.png. Cause: js/home.js:1356-1362 (calls FM.collab.ui.share(), which runs armShare, js/collab-ui.js:968-994); U.openPeople js/collab-ui.js:1170-1180 avoids exactly this on the phone.
findings.suggested_fix: On a phone, route Home's item through U.openPeople (Friends block, Start sharing). Label it by state: 'Share live…' when not shared, 'Sharing · manage…' plus 'Stop sharing' when live or paused.

findings.title: Once used, the cog opens with Friends big, which hides Canvas settings and the only door to App settings
findings.what_happens: The cog is labelled 'Canvas settings', but after he has opened Friends once it reopens with Canvas collapsed to a bar. 'App settings…' then measures 0×0 until he taps ⤢ on the Canvas bar.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: This adds a hidden step on the route to the Labs switch, and the cog no longer opens what its label says.
findings.evidence: 18-cog-reopens-friends-big.png; s7: {big:true, appset:{w:0,h:0}}. Cause: js/app.js:8184-8215 (fm.cvPair remembered), js/app.js:7059-7066.
findings.suggested_fix: Keep an 'App settings…' way in visible from the Friends view too (for example in its foot or header).

findings.title: Small wording and overlap problems around stopping and removing
findings.what_happens: After Stop sharing, the block says 'Not shared yet' (odd right after sharing), and the 'Sharing stopped' toast sits on top of the 'Opening this never shares anything…' line. The removed guest's phone banner is cut off: 'You were removed from this projec…'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Small, but 'yet' reads as if sharing never happened, and the cut-off banner hides the half that reassures ('your copy stays on this device').
findings.evidence: 17-after-stop.png, 37-guest-removed.png. Cause: stateLine js/collab-ui.js:401-406; the removed banner has no short phone form, js/collab-ui.js:3398-3400 (other states use `short`).
findings.suggested_fix: Say 'Not shared' or 'Sharing is off' after a stop. Give the removed and ended banners the short phone sentence the other states already have.

journeys.journey: J4 — every other surface that touches sharing, on a 390x844 touch phone (v17.05): Home (⎇ Join, card ⋯ → Share live… / Earlier versions…, a live project's card, a shared copy's card), the collaboration banner in each state, the knock card, the people chip, comments, Settings → Labs (Live collaboration, Codes only, pointers/selections, Test connection), Earlier versions / save points. Two real phones were simulated as two separate headless Chromes paired with the connection-code exchange (no relays, no outside services).
journeys.walked:
All screenshots are in /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ezrasmith-Claude-FreeMotion/fde0eeaf-7d73-45b8-9f83-7761553e344d/scratchpad/a967/j4/. The driver is drv.py there, and each step is scripted in s1–s17.py.
1. Home with Labs off: no sharing door at all (01-home-labs-off.png). Home cog → Settings: 28 labels. "Live collaboration (preview)" is the 22nd, 3538px into a 3694px scroll (4.9 screens), under six diagnostic "Your last…" report boxes. The word "Labs" does not appear anywhere in Settings (02, 03-settings-bottom-labs-off.png). Flipping it on shows six sub-rows (04-settings-labs-on.png).
2. Home with Labs on: a ⎇ glyph appears left of Search (05-home-labs-on.png; zoom in 05b-home-join-glyph-zoom.png). Card ⋯ now lists Share live… and Earlier versions… (06-home-card-menu.png).
3. Tapped ⎇: the name/colour prompt (07), then the Join sheet (08). A short code on localhost gives "Couldn't reach the free connection service" plus a Connect-with-a-code button (09, 10). Garbage text gives "That does not look like an invite link or a code." (11).
4. Earlier versions… on a never-shared project: "No save points yet" (12). Share live… from Home opens the project, then the profile prompt (13).
5. Two devices: owner A opened the project and tapped the stage person+ → Friends block → Start sharing → Connect with a code instead. That gave the offer code (14–17). Guest B went Home → ⎇ → pasted it and got the answer code (18). A pasted it back, both screens showed the same 5 letters (19, 20), and A tapped They match. Result: peers 1, and both stages show a face chip (21–24).
6. Guest tapped the chip → guest panel in Canvas settings (25) → Comments → posted (26, 30). The owner received it (count 1, ruler mark, playhead relabelled) with no notice (31, 32). Guest Follow → "Following Ezra ×" banner (33). Owner changed Sam's role to Viewer (34) → guest toast plus "View only — ask for edit access" (35). Home while live: owner card "LIVE · 1" (36, 36b zoom), guest "SHARED · Shared by Ezra · live now" (37), guest ⋯ menu (38).
7. Knock card raised through U.knock, because relays are refused on localhost: in the editor (39) and on Home (40). Earlier versions after sharing lists the save point (41). Stop sharing → confirm (42) → owner (43) → guest banner ended, truncated (44). Guest Home after the end (46). Restore → confirm → "Saved as … on Home" (47–49).
8. Owner's browser killed → guest banner "Offline…" truncated (50), guest panel (51), Home (52), reopen (53, 54).
9. Settings → Test connection (55, 56). Codes only on, then Join from Settings (57).
10. Labs switched off mid-session: by the guest (58, 59) and by the owner (62). No confirmation either time. The owner got no notice when the guest dropped (60). Guest Home afterwards (61).
11. After Stop sharing, the owner still has the comment, but the Friends block has no Comments door (63, 64). Guest reopened the ended copy (65–67).
12. Guest app relaunch (reload): banner "Shared by Ezra · not connected", and the panel explains how to rejoin (68, 70). Plain Delete… on the owner's LIVE project (71, 72). Plain Delete… on the guest's live shared copy (74, 75). After that, the guest's OWN project shows a stale Offline banner, still there 15 s later (76, 77).
13. The guest opened their own other project mid-session: dropped silently, and the stale banner appeared on their project (78). Back to the shared copy: not connected (79). The owner created and opened a new project mid-session: the guest dropped to Offline (81). The owner's Home shows no sign that the old project is still a shared room (82). Reopening it re-armed sharing with the toast "Sharing is on again — people can reconnect", but the guest never came back (peers 0) (83).
14. Labs off: the Friends bar says "Share it live with friends" (84). Opened, it says "you can turn it off again in Settings → Labs" and shows an on switch (85). After switching on there is no off switch left in the dialog: 0 role=switch elements in #canvas-dialog (86).
works: The two-phone connection-code route works end to end with no server. Owner Friends block → Start sharing → Connect with a code instead, then guest Home ⎇ → paste → answer code back → both screens show the same 5 letters → They match. Measured: peers 1, guest role editor, faces on both stages (17–24).
The name-and-colour prompt is short and clear, with 8 big swatches and Continue/Cancel (07). It is asked once, at the first Share or Join.

The Join sheet is plain. It has Paste and a QR scan button, error lines in plain words ('That does not look like an invite link or a code.'), and a 'Connect with a code instead' fallback that tells the person what to ask for (08–11).

Home badges carry real state while live. The owner's card shows 'LIVE · 1'. The guest's copy shows a SHARED badge in the owner's colour and 'Shared by Ezra · live now' (36, 37). The guest's ⋯ menu correctly swaps Duplicate/Share/Save-as-template for 'Keep as my own copy' and 'Leave & delete' (38).
Knock card: one clear sentence ('Jordan (iPhone) wants to join as Editor.'), the five check letters, and two big buttons. It sits above everything in the editor and on Home (39, 40).

The people chip works as a door. The coloured initial appears top-left of the stage, goes grey when that person is offline, and a tap opens the right panel (guest panel for a guest, Share panel for the owner) (23, 25, 51).

Follow works and says so: the banner 'Following Ezra' has a working × (33). A role change is told to the guest as a toast ('Ezra made you a Viewer') plus the banner, and the + and editing controls go away (35).
The comments card is good once found: paper look, 'At 0:00 on the timeline' pin, Post. The comment syncs to the owner at once, with count and ruler mark (26, 30, 31).

Earlier versions works. A save point is written when sharing starts. Restore asks first and says the result inside the row ('Saved as “Untitled — 26 Sept, 22:57” on Home'). The copy really appears on Home (41, 47–49).

The not-connected panel for a code-joined copy explains exactly what to do: 'To get back in, ask Ezra for a new code — joining again starts from Ezra's copy, and what you changed here stays in this one.' (70). The phone banner 'Shared by Ezra · not connected' fits (68).
The Stop sharing confirm is honest: 'Everyone here keeps their own copy. The codes you have handed out stop working.' (42). The guest's banner then switches to ended (44).
Settings Labs rows (Change…, Join…, Test) open their card on top of Settings and come back to the same scroll position (stayRow).

findings.title: The Labs switch is buried and misnamed, and once it is on nothing near the feature turns it off
findings.what_happens: With Labs off, the Friends block in Canvas settings shows its own on switch and the line 'you can turn it off again in Settings → Labs' (85). After it is flipped on, the dialog has no off switch at all: 0 role=switch elements in #canvas-dialog (86). The only off switch is in app Settings, where no section or row is called 'Labs'. The switch is labelled 'Live collaboration (preview)', is the 22nd of 28 labels, and sits 3538px into a 3694px scroll (about 4.9 screens), under six diagnostic 'Your last export / playback / project open / scrub / Back / A clip with no picture' report boxes (02, 03).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: This is exactly Ezra's complaint: 'there's a switch to turn it on, but you can never turn it off'. The on switch sits where the feature is. The off switch is five screens down a different panel, under developer reports, and the app's own directions ('Settings → Labs') name a heading that does not exist.
findings.evidence: 02-settings-top.png, 03-settings-bottom-labs-off.png, 85-friends-labs-off-open.png, 86-friends-after-switch-on.png. Measured: labels index 21 of 28, labTop 3538/scrollHeight 3694, 'Labs' found in panel text = false. js/settings.js:914-986 (Labs group appended last with no heading); js/collab-ui.js:1110 ('Settings → Labs' text).
findings.suggested_fix: Put a visible off switch where the on switch was: a 'Live sharing: On' row or switch in the Friends block while Labs is on. In Settings, give the group a real 'Labs' heading and move it above the diagnostic Reports (or move the Reports into their own collapsible section). Make the Friends-block text name the row that really exists.

findings.title: Opening any other project silently drops a code-joined guest for good, and the owner is told people can reconnect when they can't
findings.what_happens: Guest case: mid-session the guest went Home and tapped their own other project. The session ended at once with no warning (active false), the owner's chip vanished with no notice (peers 0), and going back to the shared copy only shows 'Shared by Ezra · not connected' (78, 79). Owner case: the owner created and opened 'Project 2' from Home with no warning. The guest fell to 'Offline — the live link dropped…' (81). When the owner reopened the shared project, the toast said 'Sharing is on again — people can reconnect', but the guest never came back (peers 0 after 4 s and later) (83). An app relaunch on the guest's phone (iOS does this constantly) has the same result (68).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Hopping between projects is normal on a phone. Nothing says it ends the live session, and there is no way back without swapping two long codes again. The owner's toast actively misleads: it promises a reconnect that only exists on the relay/link route.
findings.evidence: 78-guest-switches-to-own-project.png, 79-guest-back-to-shared-copy.png, 81-guest-when-owner-switched-project.png, 83-owner-back-on-shared-project.png, 68-guest-home-after-app-relaunch.png. js/storage.js:2518 (onReset force on every open); js/collab-core.js:340-348 (stop('paused') + detach); js/collab-ui.js:3751 (the toast).
findings.suggested_fix: When a live session is running, ask before opening another project ('You're live with Sam — opening another project pauses it. Sam will need a new code to rejoin'). Word the resume toast by route: for code-joined guests say 'Sam will need a new code'. Tell the owner when someone drops ('Sam left').

findings.title: Stale red 'Offline' banner sticks on the guest's own, unshared project
findings.what_happens: After the guest leaves the shared copy by opening another project (78), or by plain Delete… on the shared copy from Home (74–76), their own ordinary project shows the red 'Offline — the live link dropped; yo…' banner. It is still there 15 s later (77). That project has no collab record (collab: null) and there is no session (active false).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: It tells them their own private project is a broken live link, and nothing on screen explains or clears it.
findings.evidence: 76-guest-own-project-after-deleting-shared-copy.png, 77-guest-own-project-15s-later.png, 78-guest-switches-to-own-project.png. Measured: {active:false, banner visible, collab:null}. Cause: js/collab-ui.js:3691 U.onDetach never calls U.syncBanner()/hideBanner(); the banner set during stop('paused') outlives the detach, and U.resumeOpen returns null for a plain project without re-syncing.
findings.suggested_fix: Call U.syncBanner() (or hideBanner) at the end of U.onDetach, and in resumeOpen's no-collab/no-room return path. Add a test: guest opens a non-shared project mid-session → no #collab-banner.

findings.title: Ended and Offline banners are cut mid-sentence on a phone, losing the reassuring half
findings.what_happens: On a 390px phone the banner pill is 250px wide. 'This live session has ended — your…' and 'Offline — the live link dropped; yo…' are clipped: measured cb-text scrollWidth > clientWidth. The part that says the work is safe ('your copy stays on this device' / 'your changes are kept on this device') is the part that is lost (44, 50). Other states already have a phone-short form, and these two do not.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: A red pill saying only 'session has ended — your…' or 'link dropped; yo…' reads as 'you lost your work', at the exact moment they need reassurance.
findings.evidence: 44-guest-home-after-owner-stopped.png, 50-guest-owner-gone-banner.png. Measured {clipped:true, w:250}. js/collab-ui.js:3410-3412 (ended/removed have no isPhoneNow short form), js/collab-ui.js:3441 (offline has no short form).
findings.suggested_fix: Add phone short forms like the other states, e.g. 'Session ended · your copy is safe', 'Removed · your copy is safe', 'Offline · changes kept'. Better still, let a tap on the pill open the guest panel with the full sentence.

findings.title: Comments are nearly impossible to find, and nobody is told when one arrives
findings.what_happens: There is no comment button anywhere in the phone editor. The only door is the people chip or person+ → Canvas settings → Friends → a 'Comments' row, and only while a session is live (25). When the guest posted, the owner got no toast or badge. The only sign was a tiny speech-bubble merged into the playhead's head on the ruler (31). After Stop sharing, the comment is still there (count 1), but the Friends block no longer has a Comments row (64). The linked-copy panel has none either (70). The only way in is tapping that ruler mark. With Labs off the comments are invisible entirely.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Nobody would think to look for comments inside Canvas settings. A new comment is effectively silent, and after the session ends the comments are stranded.
findings.evidence: 25-guest-taps-chip.png, 31-owner-sees-comment-arrive.png, 32-owner-ruler-comment-mark.png, 63-owner-after-stop-comment-still-there.png, 64-owner-friends-after-stop-no-comments-door.png. js/collab-ui.js:947 commentsRow used only in drawShare/guest panel; drawFriendsIdle js/collab-ui.js:1065 and drawLinkedPanel omit it; js/collab-comments.js:192-197 only ever toasts your own actions.
findings.suggested_fix: Give comments a door of their own on the phone stage or top bar, with an unread count on it. Toast or badge 'Sam commented' on arrival. Keep the Comments row in the idle and linked panels whenever the project has comments.

findings.title: The Home 'Join' button is a tiny meaningless text glyph (⎇)
findings.what_happens: With Labs on, Home gains a round button left of Search whose face is the character U+2387, drawn as Arial text at 13px. At phone size it reads as a small squiggle like '⌿' (05, 05b). It has no label, and it is the only door on Home for joining a friend's project. The other door is 'Join…' at the very bottom of Settings.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: A guest who has just been sent an invite has no idea this squiggle means 'Join a live project'. Every other Home icon is a drawn SVG, so this one also looks broken. It also sits 8px from the wordmark.
findings.evidence: 05-home-labs-on.png, 05b-home-join-glyph-zoom.png. Measured: font Arial 13.33px, rect 38x38 at x=157.7, brand right edge 149.7. js/collab-ui.js:3965-3977 (b.textContent = '⎇').
findings.suggested_fix: Draw a proper icon (e.g. a person+arrow or 'enter' mark) as SVG like its neighbours, or make it a labelled pill ('Join'). Show him options at 24px first.

findings.title: A project he once shared stays a live room with no sign on Home, and re-arms itself when opened
findings.what_happens: The owner opened another project while sharing, which pauses the room but keeps it. Back on Home, the shared project's card has no badge or subtitle at all ('Untitled · edited just now', 82). Opening it later starts sharing again by itself: relays and link come back, with the toast 'Sharing is on again — people can reconnect' (83).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Nothing on Home says this project is still shared. Opening it silently makes it reachable again with the old link and code, which a first-timer would not expect and did not choose.
findings.evidence: 82-owner-home-after-switch.png, 83-owner-back-on-shared-project.png. js/home.js:1260-1270 (collabOf only marks a CURRENT owner session or a guest copy; a kept host room is invisible); js/collab-ui.js:3740-3752 (resumeHost auto-arms).
findings.suggested_fix: Badge a paused room on Home ('SHARED · paused'). Either ask on open ('Start sharing again?') or at least put a 'Stop sharing' item in that card's ⋯ menu.

findings.title: Turning Labs off mid-session ends it for everyone with no warning, and nobody is told when someone leaves
findings.what_happens: The guest flipped 'Live collaboration' off in Settings mid-session: no confirmation, silently left, and no toast saying they had left (58, 59). Their Home now shows two identical 'Untitled' cards with nothing to tell them apart (61). The owner flipped it off while live: no confirmation, and the session ended for the guest at once (62). When the guest dropped, the owner's chip just vanished with no 'Sam left' (60). The switch's hint says nothing about ending live sessions.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: A 'preview' switch deep in Settings reads as a harmless display option. Flipping it kicks everyone out without a word, and the other side just sees a face disappear.
findings.evidence: 58-guest-turns-labs-off-mid-session.png, 59-guest-after-labs-off.png, 60-owner-when-guest-labs-off.png, 61-guest-home-labs-off.png, 62-owner-turns-labs-off-while-live.png. js/collab-ui.js U.syncLabs (C.leave / C.end with no ask); js/settings.js:980-984 (switchRow toggles immediately). No 'left' toast exists in js/collab-ui.js or js/collab-presence.js (only 'joined' / 'is back').
findings.suggested_fix: When a session is live, confirm first ('This ends your live session with Sam'). Toast 'Sam left' on the owner's side and 'You left Ezra's project' on the guest's.

findings.title: The guest's Home card never says the session ended or is disconnected
findings.what_happens: After the owner stopped sharing, or after the owner's device went away, the guest's copy still reads 'SHARED · Shared by Ezra' with nothing after it (46, 52, 67). The ⋯ menu still offers 'Keep as my own copy' / 'Leave & delete'. An ended copy is also detached only on a later fresh open.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The card looks exactly like one they could open and keep collaborating in.
findings.evidence: 46-guest-home-after-reopen.png, 52-guest-home-after-owner-gone.png, 67-guest-home-after-reopening-ended.png. js/home.js:1308 (cx.ended ? '' — ended adds no words; seen stamp absent for a code guest).
findings.suggested_fix: Subtitle 'Shared by Ezra · ended' or '· not connected' and dim the SHARED badge.

findings.title: Plain 'Delete…' on a live project doesn't mention the people in it; the shared copy has two deletes
findings.what_happens: On the owner's LIVE · 1 card, Delete… asks only 'Delete "Untitled"? This cannot be undone.' Confirming it silently ends the session for the guest (71, 72). On the guest's shared copy the menu shows both 'Leave & delete' and a separate 'Delete…' with the generic wording (74).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The owner isn't warned that deleting cuts off the person working in it, and two delete entries on one card is confusing.
findings.evidence: 71-owner-delete-live-project-ask.png, 72-owner-after-deleting-live-project.png, 74-guest-plain-delete-on-live-shared-copy.png. js/home.js:1432-1435.
findings.suggested_fix: On a live card, say 'Sam is working in this now — deleting ends the session for everyone'. On a shared copy, drop the plain Delete… and keep 'Leave & delete'.

findings.title: 'Earlier versions…' is on every project card but only ever has content for shared ones
findings.what_happens: With Labs on, every card's ⋯ shows 'Earlier versions…'. On a project that was never shared it always says 'No save points yet — they are made while you share this project.' (12).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: 'Earlier versions' sounds like general version history. Someone who wrecked a normal project would try it and find nothing.
findings.evidence: 06-home-card-menu.png, 12-earlier-versions-unshared.png. js/home.js:1366-1367.
findings.suggested_fix: Show it only when the project has save points, or rename it 'Save points from sharing…'.

findings.title: The LIVE · 1 badge overlaps the duration pill on the owner's Home card
findings.what_happens: On the thumbnail, the red 'LIVE · 1' sits on top of '0:00'. Measured: duration pill right edge 67px, LIVE left edge 60px, so 7px of overlap (36b).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: It looks broken ('0:00LIVE · 1').
findings.evidence: 36-owner-home-while-live.png, 36b-live-badge-zoom.png. styles.css:5054-5055 (.hm-live bottom:5px right:5px, same row as .hm-dur).
findings.suggested_fix: Move the owner's LIVE badge to the top-right, or stack it above the duration as the SHARED badge already does (styles.css:5058).

findings.title: Knock card doesn't say which project, and its two-minute auto-decline is invisible
findings.what_happens: On Home the card reads 'Jordan wants to join as Viewer.' with no project name (40). It declines itself after 2 minutes with no countdown or hint.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Someone with several projects, or who shared one and went Home, can't tell which project is being asked about, and a request can vanish while they read.
findings.evidence: 39-owner-knock-card-editor.png, 40-owner-knock-card-on-home.png. js/collab-ui.js:3288 (text), 3303-3309 (silent 120 s timeout).
findings.suggested_fix: 'Jordan wants to join “Untitled” as Viewer', plus a small 'asks again in 2 min' line or a shrinking bar.

findings.title: Jargon in the Labs section, Test connection and the profile prompt
findings.what_happens: The switch hint names 'relays run by PeerJS, EMQX and HiveMQ, and Google and Cloudflare's address lookup' (8 lines at 390px) (03). 'Connect with codes only' assumes the reader knows what a relay is. Test connection answers '3.1 MB/s between two connections here, messages up to 256 KB', then a raw report (SDP bytes, maxMessageSize, user-agent) (55, 56). The name prompt says 'beside your cursor' on a phone (07). 'Show others' pointers' says 'mouse pointer'.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: None of it answers the question a first-timer has ('will this work with my friend?'), and the provider names read as scary.
findings.evidence: 03-settings-bottom-labs-off.png, 55-labs-test-connection-result.png, 56-labs-test-connection-report.png, 07-join-tap-first-profile.png. js/settings.js:974-982; js/collab-ui.js:189.
findings.suggested_fix: Lead with one plain line ('Lets you and friends edit the same project from your own phones'), and move the provider list behind a 'Privacy details' link. Test result: 'Works on this phone ✓ / Invite links: work / don't work here'. 'Beside your cursor' becomes 'next to what you're doing'.

findings.title: 'View only — ask for edit access' has no way to ask
findings.what_happens: A Viewer gets a permanent banner 'View only — ask for edit access' (35). It has no button, and the guest panel has no 'Ask for edit access' action anywhere.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The app tells them to do something it gives them no way to do.
findings.evidence: 35-guest-view-only-banner.png. js/collab-ui.js:3454; grep for any request-edit action in js/collab-*.js finds none.
findings.suggested_fix: Add an 'Ask' action on the banner that knocks the owner ('Sam asks for edit access · Allow / Not now'), or reword it to 'View only — Ezra can change this'.

findings.title: After Stop sharing the owner's panel says 'Not shared yet', and the toast covers the card
findings.what_happens: Straight after Stop sharing, the Friends block heads 'Share “Untitled” — Not shared yet', and the 'Sharing stopped' toast is painted over the card's own text (43). The guest panel on an ended copy still says 'You're an Editor.' (66), and the offline owner row still offers Follow (51).
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Small contradictions about what state they are in.
findings.evidence: 43-owner-after-stop.png, 66-guest-person-plus-on-ended-copy.png, 51-guest-panel-while-offline.png. js/collab-ui.js:401-402 (stateLine 'Not shared yet' for any no-session state).
findings.suggested_fix: Say 'Not sharing' after a stop. Drop the role line on an ended copy, and hide Follow for an offline person.

journeys.journey: J5 — the WORDS: every string a first-time phone user can read in live collaboration, judged for jargon, length on a 390px screen, inconsistent names, and promises the screen doesn't keep. Also checked whether anything explains the feature in 2–3 steps.
journeys.walked:
All runs were in the real app (v17.05, localhost:8777) at 390x844 with a notch and touch emulation, using my own CDP driver (scratchpad/a967/j5-words/drive.py). All screenshots are under /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-ezrasmith-Claude-FreeMotion/fde0eeaf-7d73-45b8-9f83-7761553e344d/scratchpad/a967/j5-words/.
1. Fresh device, Home (01-home-fresh.png). No word about collaboration anywhere.
2. Home cog → Settings, scrolled to the switch (02-settings-labs-off.png). Settings has no heading called "Labs". The switch is labelled "Live collaboration (preview)" and is row 22 of 28 on Home, after the developer diagnostics. Its hint is 9 lines long.
3. Flipped it through the real switch (03-settings-labs-on-top.png, 04-settings-labs-on-bottom.png). Five more rows appear, including "Join a live project", "Test connection" and "Connect with codes only".
4. Home with the feature on (05-home-labs-on.png). The only new thing is a ⎇ glyph button beside the logo, with no words.
5. In a project with the feature off (10-editor-labs-off.png). Cog → Canvas settings shows a "Friends / Share it live with friends" bar (11-canvas-dialog-labs-off.png). Opening it gives "Work on this with friends" (12-friends-labs-off.png).
6. Turned it on inside that card (14-friends-idle-after-on.png). The switch disappears and the idle "Share “Untitled”" panel takes its place.
7. Pressed the person+ on the stage (20-editor-labs-on.png, 21-personplus-opens.png), then Start sharing. The name prompt appeared (22-profile-prompt.png). Typed Ezra and got the live Share panel (23-share-live-top.png, 25-share-live-bottom.png). Relays are refused on localhost, so the relay line reads "Couldn’t reach the free connection service"; that part is a localhost artefact, not a bug.
8. Opened the ⚙ Sharing settings (26-sharing-settings-top.png, 27-…mid, 28-…bottom), then Earlier versions (29-earlier-versions.png). Opened Connect with a code instead (30-code-step-top.png, 31-code-step-bottom.png). Opened the Stop sharing confirm (32-stop-sharing-ask.png).
9. Fresh device, Home ⎇ → name prompt (40-join-profile-first.png) → Join sheet (41-join-sheet.png). Typed a short code and pressed Join (42-join-shortcode-result.png).
10. A real two-device join with no relay, in two separate headless Chromes, using the long connection-code exchange:
   - The owner's Step 1 code went to the guest's Join sheet. The guest was told "READ THIS BACK TO THEM" above a 201-character code (50-guest-read-this-back.png).
   - The owner pasted it back and got Step 3 (51-owner-step3-letters.png). The guest saw "READ THESE LETTERS BACK TO THEM" (52-guest-letters.png).
   - Both sides pressed They match. The guest landed in the editor with only an "E" chip showing (53-guest-after-join.png). The owner saw only an "S" chip (55-owner-editor-live.png).
   - Guest panel (56-guest-panel.png) and the Leave confirm (57-guest-leave-ask.png).
11. Invite link with the feature off, on a non-iOS phone (63-invite-link-labs-off-android.png) → Turn on → name (64-invite-after-turn-on.png) → Join filled in (65-invite-join-prefilled.png). Also the iOS landing card (60-invite-link-ios-landing… saved as 60-invite-link-labs-off.png and 62-invite-link-ios-landing.png).
12. The knock card, drawn in a live session by calling FM.collab.ui.knock directly rather than by a real guest (70-knock-card.png).
13. From a project, Canvas settings → App settings… and measured the Settings scroll (80-appsettings-from-project-top.png). The switch is 3979px down a 4889px panel, 5.3 screens, row 25, with no Labs heading.
14. Pulled every string literal (comments stripped) from collab-ui.js, collab-comments.js, collab-presence.js, collab-media.js, the Labs block in settings.js and index.html (ui-strings.txt in the same folder), and counted words in the longest ones.
I did not run Test connection, because it may try outside lookups; its wording is judged from the code.
works: The knock card is short and plain: 'Sam (phone) wants to join as Editor.' with Don’t allow / Let in (70-knock-card.png). Keep it.

The invite LINK with the feature off is the best-worded flow in the feature. 'Turn on Live collaboration to join' → one tap Turn on → name → Join filled in with 'Tap Join to connect to this project.' (63/64/65 screenshots). This is the pattern the short-code route is missing.

The connection-code exchange numbers its steps: 'Step 1 · send them this code', 'Step 2 · paste the code they send back', 'Step 3 · check…' (30, 51). Numbered steps are the right shape; only the other person's half is unexplained.

The failure sentences are human and actionable, e.g. 'Couldn’t connect directly. Put both devices on the same Wi-Fi, or turn off mobile data.' and 'This project is full — ask Ezra to make room.' (relayError, collab-ui.js:3219-3241). They also name the person where they can.
The Stop sharing confirm and the Leave confirm bodies are short and honest about what happens to each person's copy (32, 57).
'The short code stops working 30 minutes after you close this.' is clear and true (23-share-live-top.png).
The name prompt 'What should others see?' is short and has only one field (22-profile-prompt.png).
The Friends bar state line is a good one-glance status: '● Live · waiting for someone' / '1 person here' / 'Not shared yet · invite people'.
The phone-host toast 'Keep FreeMotion open — the session pauses when your screen locks' says the one thing a phone host has to know (collab-ui.js:1044).

findings.title: The app says 'Settings → Labs' in four places, but Settings has no Labs. The off switch is 5 screens down under another name, and the card that turned it on stops showing a switch.
findings.what_happens: The Friends card says 'you can turn it off again in Settings → Labs'. The invite cards say 'turn it on in Settings → Labs' and '(Settings → Labs)', and a Join error says 'Codes only is on in Settings → Labs'. Settings has no Labs heading anywhere. The real switch is labelled 'Live collaboration (preview)': row 22 of 28 from Home, and row 25 at 3979px of a 4889px panel (5.3 screens) when opened from a project, below six developer diagnostics ('Your last scrub', 'Your last Back from an effects category', 'A clip with no picture'…). Once it is turned on in the Friends card, the card redraws as 'Share “Untitled”' with no switch, so the place where you turned it on is not where you turn it off.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: This is exactly Ezra's complaint: 'there's a switch to turn it on, but you can never turn it off on any project ever'. The words send you to a section that doesn't exist, and the switch you used has vanished.
findings.evidence: collab-ui.js:1110, 2975, 3828, 3849 (the four 'Settings → Labs' strings). settings.js:164 (group() has no title) and :979-987 (the switch row). Screens 02-settings-labs-off.png, 12-friends-labs-off.png, 14-friends-idle-after-on.png (no switch after turning on), 80-appsettings-from-project-top.png (measured: scrollH 4889, switch at 3979, 25 labels before it).
findings.suggested_fix: (1) Keep an off switch in the Friends card itself, e.g. a quiet footer row 'Work with friends · On [switch]' with 'Switch this off any time.' (2) Either add a real 'Labs' heading above the group in Settings, or stop saying 'Labs' and name the real path, e.g. 'Settings → Work with friends (right at the bottom)'. (3) Rename the Settings row to the same name the card uses (see the naming finding).

findings.title: Nowhere explains what live collaboration is or how it works in 2–3 steps
findings.what_happens: The only 'what is it' sentence is in the off-state Friends card: 'Share this project live and edit it together from your own phones or computers.' It disappears once the feature is on. The idle panel then shows 'Share “Untitled” / Not shared yet / You — pick the name and colour others will see / Start sharing / Opening this never shares anything by itself. / New people join as Editor ▾'. Nothing says what Start sharing gives you, or that you then send a link, or what your friend has to do. Home's Tutorials tab says 'Tutorials are coming'. The owner is never told the friend needs FreeMotion open, or where they type a short code.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: Someone who has never used it doesn't know the shape of the job (turn on → send link → friend taps it → you're both in), so every screen after that is a guess. Ezra asked for it to make sense 'for someone who doesn't know how to use it'.
findings.evidence: collab-ui.js:1110 (the only explainer, off-state only). collab-ui.js:1071-1098 (drawFriendsIdle: no how-to). home.js:2480 ('Tutorials are coming'). Screens 12-friends-labs-off.png, 14-friends-idle-after-on.png.
findings.suggested_fix: Put a three-line 'How it works' in the Friends card, both before and after it's switched on, e.g.: '1. Tap Start sharing  2. Send your mate the link  3. They tap it and you're both editing, live'. Under Start sharing: 'You'll get a link to send.' Replace 'Opening this never shares anything by itself.' with 'Nothing's shared until you tap Start sharing.' Show him drawn options for where the three steps sit.

findings.title: 'Code' means two different things on one card, and the guest is told to 'read back' a 201-character code
findings.what_happens: On the live Share card, 'Invite with a link or a code' means the 9-character short code (6YT-BGG-SDZ). Six rows lower, 'Connect with a code instead' means a 233-character FM1-… block. Other names for these: 'short code', 'long code', 'connection code', 'Codes only', 'Add someone with a code', 'Having trouble? Connect with a code'. In the code swap, the guest's Join sheet says 'READ THIS BACK TO THEM' above a 201-character code. The developers already knew this was wrong: the comment at collab-ui.js:1246 bans 'read out' for this blob. The SAS step says 'check these LETTERS match' for 'G8C8J', which has digits, and 'They must see the same five' without saying five what.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: 'Use the code' is ambiguous on the very card where they choose. The guest cannot read 201 characters aloud, so they either try to and fail, or don't know to copy and message it back.
findings.evidence: collab-ui.js:1363 ('Invite with a link or a code'), :1243 ('Connect with a code instead'), :2640 ('Read this back to them'), :2168 and :2951 (SAS labels), :2952. Screens 25-share-live-bottom.png (both 'codes' on one screen), 50-guest-read-this-back.png, 51-owner-step3-letters.png, 52-guest-letters.png.
findings.suggested_fix: Two different nouns. The 9-character one is always the 'short code'. Call the long one a 'swap code' (or 'backup code'), and never the bare word 'code'. Rewrites: 'Invite with a link or a code' → 'Send your mates the link' plus a row 'Or tell them this short code (works for 30 min)'. 'Connect with a code instead' → 'Link not working? Swap codes instead', with the sub 'You copy a long code to them, they copy one back.' 'Read this back to them' → 'Now copy this and send it back to them' (the Copy button is already there). SAS: 'Step 3 · Check you both see the same 5 characters' / 'Different? Tap They don't match — someone else might be trying to get in.'

findings.title: A friend given a SHORT CODE has nowhere to type it: no Join button exists until they find the hidden switch, and the one that appears is an unlabelled ⎇
findings.what_happens: The owner's card offers a short code 'somebody read you', and the Join sheet says 'type the short code they read out'. But on a device with the feature off (every new device) there is no Join anywhere. The Home ⎇ button and the Settings 'Join a live project' row only exist once the switch is on, 5 screens down in Settings. The link route has a helpful 'Turn on Live collaboration to join' card; the short-code route has nothing. Even once it's on, Join is a lone '⎇' glyph beside the logo, with no text. Its title tooltip never shows on touch, which is why the iOS landing card has to say 'On Home, tap ⎇ (Join a live project)'. The stage invite button (person+, 28px) also has no words.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: The person receiving a code by voice is by definition new to this. No screen tells them where to type it, and the one button that would take it is hidden and unnamed.
findings.evidence: collab-ui.js:3964-3977 (makeJoinButton: '⎇', title only), :3955 (person+ title only), settings.js:917 ('set-labs hidden' when off), collab-ui.js:3828-3829 (landing-card steps that have to describe ⎇). Screens 01-home-fresh.png (no Join), 05-home-labs-on.png (the ⎇ glyph), 60-invite-link-labs-off.png, 20-editor-labs-on.png (unlabelled person+).
findings.suggested_fix: Give Home a worded 'Join' pill (like 'Select') that shows even with the feature off. Tapped while it's off, it shows the same one-tap 'Turn on to join' card the link route uses. Under the short code on the owner's card, add: 'They open FreeMotion, tap Join on Home, and type it in.' Rewrite the Join sheet line to 'Tap the link your mate sent, or type the short code they told you.' Show him options for the Join pill and the person+ label before shipping.

findings.title: Networking jargon everywhere, and a 68-word privacy paragraph repeated in four places
findings.what_happens: A first-timer reads: 'relays run by PeerJS, EMQX and HiveMQ, and Google and Cloudflare’s address lookup', 'when a room is in use', 'anyone watching those relays', 'No relay at all', 'No free relay at all', 'Starting the relay…', 'Codes only skips them all' (on the switch, before 'Codes only' has been introduced), 'the free connection service(s)', 'this device’s live connections', 'this network hides this device’s address', 'somebody is in the middle', 'session', 'encrypted'. The privacy paragraph is 68 words / 390 characters, 8 lines at 390px. It appears in the off-state Friends card, at the bottom of the Share card and at the bottom of Sharing settings. A 57-word variant is the 9-line hint on the Settings switch itself.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: People who 'know no networking' can't tell whether it's safe or what to do. The one thing they must know (your project goes phone to phone; some free helpers see your internet address) is buried in five company names. The wall of text is also the tallest thing on the first card they meet.
findings.evidence: collab-ui.js:1564 (PRIVACY_LINE; word count measured 68), settings.js:982 (57 words, 9 lines in 02-settings-labs-off.png), collab-ui.js:1245, 1436, 1596, 1605, 1597, 2906, 2170, 2952; settings.js:926, 974. Screens 12-friends-labs-off.png, 25-share-live-bottom.png, 28-sharing-settings-bottom.png.
findings.suggested_fix: Show one short line, with the full, accurate version behind 'More about privacy'. For example: 'Your project goes straight from phone to phone, locked so only you lot can see it. To find each other, the phones use a few free helpers online — they see your internet address, never your project.' Settings hint: 'Edit the same project live with friends, each on your own phone. Still being tested.' 'Starting the relay…' → 'Getting your link ready…'. 'Couldn’t reach the free connection service — use Connect with a code below.' → 'Your link can’t get through on this network right now — try Swap codes instead, below.' 'Connect with codes only' → 'Swap codes only (no online helpers)', with the hint 'Links and short codes stop working; you swap a long code with each person instead.' 'somebody is in the middle — stop' → 'someone else might be trying to get in — tap They don't match.'

findings.title: About a dozen different names for the one feature
findings.what_happens: Names a first-timer meets for the same thing: 'Live collaboration (preview)' (Settings), 'Live collaboration' (Friends switch and invite cards), 'Live sharing is still being tested', 'Friends' (the bar), 'Work on this with friends', 'Share it live with friends', 'Share “Untitled”', 'Share live…' (Home ⋯ menu), 'Share' (person+ aria-label, plus 'tap Share →' instructions), 'Join a live project', 'live session', 'Shared with you', 'Sharing settings', plus 'Labs', 'preview', 'Being tested'. The off-state card says 'being tested' three times.
findings.why_it_fails_a_first_timer: When the words change on every screen, a newcomer can't tell whether 'Friends', 'Live collaboration' and 'Share' are the same thing or three things, so they can't follow instructions that use one name to point at another.
findings.suggested_fix: Pick one family and use it everywhere, e.g. the feature is 'Work with friends', the action is 'Share live' and the other side is 'Join'. Settings row: 'Work with friends (beta)'. Friends bar: 'Friends · Not shared yet'. Card: 'Share “Untitled” live'. Home ⋯: 'Share live…'. Join: 'Join a friend’s project'. Say 'still being tested' once. Drop 'session', 'preview' and 'Labs' from user-facing text.

findings.title: Instructions tell people to 'tap Share', but on a phone nothing is labelled Share
findings.what_happens: When the short code or link fails, the Join sheet offers 'Connect with a code instead'. Tapping it says: 'Ask them to tap Share → Connect with a code instead, then paste the long code they send you here.' With swap-codes-only on, it says 'ask them to tap Share → Add someone with a code'. On a phone the owner's doors are an unlabelled person+ icon on the stage, or cog → Canvas settings → 'Friends'. No visible 'Share' label exists, and the card's own heading only says 'Share “Untitled”' once you're already inside.

plan.summary_for_ezra:
The hard part works. Two phones really do connect and edit the same project live, both ways. What's broken is everything around it, and on a phone that's most of what you see:
- The only way in is the cog, which says "Canvas settings".
- The switch that turns sharing on disappears after one tap. The real off switch is at the very bottom of Settings, under test reports, and the app tells you to look in a "Labs" section that doesn't exist.
- A project you shared once turns itself back on the next time the app opens.
- Nothing on the video shows you're live.
- Your friend has no Join button until they find that buried switch, and then it's a ⎇ squiggle.
- Swapping codes gives your friend 20 seconds, so in real life it almost always fails.
- The words talk about relays and PeerJS.

The plan:
1. Fix the broken parts now. Nothing changes how it looks.
2. Draw you options for the doors: an off switch next to the on switch, a worded Join on Home, and a Live marker.
3. Show which projects are shared, and stop them sharing again by themselves.
4. Plain words and one name for the feature.
5. Comments you can find.

The invite link couldn't be tested here because it needs the online relays. It needs one real test from your phone once 1 and 2 are done.
root_causes: R1. THE ON/OFF SWITCH HAS NO HOME NEAR THE FEATURE. The Friends block shows its switch only while sharing is OFF (drawLabsOff, collab-ui.js:1102-1120). Once it's on, drawFriendsIdle/drawShare have none. The real switch is the last group of App Settings (settings.js:907-988), below seven diagnostic Reports. group() has no title (settings.js:164), so no 'Labs' heading exists, yet four sentences send people to 'Settings → Labs' (collab-ui.js:1110, 2975, 3828, 3849). Settings is 4.2–5.6 screens down, and from the editor it hides behind a 0×0 'App settings…' once Friends is remembered big (app.js:7059-7066, 8184-8215). This is his 'switch to turn it on, but you can never turn it off'.

R2. 'OFF' MEANS THREE DIFFERENT THINGS, AND A SHARED ROOM SURVIVES TWO OF THEM. Stop sharing deletes fm.collab.host.<pid>. Opening another project only pauses it. Turning the Labs switch off drops only the ACTIVE session's room, and that is deliberate per S6 (collab-ui.js:4076-4082). A kept room re-arms itself whenever that project opens, including at cold launch behind Home (afterReset → resumeOpen → resumeHost, collab-ui.js:3715-3752). Home shows no badge for a paused room (home.js:1260-1270), and its ⋯ offers 'Share live…' but never Stop (home.js:1356-1362). This is his 'can never turn it off on any project ever'.

R3. §23's 'NO COLLAB DOM WHILE LABS IS OFF' MEANT EVERY DOOR APPEARS ONLY AFTER THE BURIED SWITCH IS ON, AND THE DOORS THAT DO APPEAR ARE WORDLESS. On the phone there is: the cog labelled 'Canvas settings'; a 28px person+ that looks pixel-identical whether you're live or not, and is display:none whenever a layer is selected (collab-ui.js:3916-3963, styles.css:10409); and a bare '⎇' on Home (collab-ui.js:3965-3977) that doesn't exist at all with Labs off. The Friends block can only share, not join. Nothing on the stage says 'live' for owner or guest. This is his 'you can't even send it to your friends' / 'buried it all in a deeper setting'.

R4. THE NO-RELAY CODE ROUTE WAS BUILT FOR TWO PEOPLE SIDE BY SIDE. The guest's 20-second ICE_CONNECT race starts the moment their answer code appears, before the owner can possibly paste it (collab-ui.js:3179 → openedWithin 663-672, collab-core.js:50). The screen says 'Read this back to them' over a ~200-character code (2640). Step 3 'They match' lands under the pinned foot with no scroll, and a tap there hits Done (confirmSas 2164-2176). Code-joined guests never get liveness (setLiveness only on relay paths: 3084, 3578, 3593), so they sit on 'Live' after the owner's app dies. Any project switch drops them for good while the owner is told 'people can reconnect' (3751). This is also the route the app falls back to when relays fail.

R5. THE WORDS WERE WRITTEN FOR THE BUILDER, NOT A FIRST-TIMER. A 68-word paragraph naming PeerJS/EMQX/HiveMQ/Google/Cloudflare leads the first card and repeats four times (PRIVACY_LINE 1564, settings.js:982). 'Relay', 'session' and 'address lookup' appear in status lines. 'Code' means both a 9-character short code and a 233-character FM1 block on the same card. The feature has about a dozen names. Nothing explains it in three steps. Instructions name controls the phone doesn't have: 'tap Share' (3006, 2600), 'Settings → Labs', 'beside your cursor' (189).

R6. ENDINGS ARE SILENT OR HALF-SAID. There is no '<name> left' toast anywhere (owner link.onclose 2218). The Labs switch ends everything mid-session with no confirm (settings.js:984 → syncLabs). U.onDetach never re-syncs the banner, so a stale red 'Offline' sticks on the guest's own unshared project (3691-3707). The ended, removed and offline banners have no phone short form, so the reassuring half is cut off (3398-3400, 3441). The guest's Home card never says ended or not connected (home.js:1308).
